records.literal_gloss: And it was, when was old Samuel, and he made his sons judges over Israel.

en.L: And it happened, when Samuel was old, that he made his sons judges over Israel.
en.B: In his old age Samuel appointed his sons as judges over Israel.
en.R: When Samuel grew old, he made his sons judges to lead Israel.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando Samuel envejeció, puso a sus hijos como jueces sobre Israel.
es.B: Cuando Samuel llegó a viejo, nombró a sus hijos jueces sobre Israel.
es.R: Cuando Samuel envejeció, hizo que sus hijos fueran jueces para dirigir a Israel.

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand Samuel fut vieux, qu’il établit ses fils juges sur Israël.
fr.B: Devenu vieux, Samuel établit ses fils comme juges sur Israël.
fr.R: Quand Samuel est devenu vieux, il a nommé ses fils juges pour diriger Israël.

sw.L: Na ikawa, Samweli alipokuwa mzee, akawafanya wanawe kuwa waamuzi juu ya Israeli.
sw.B: Samweli alipozeeka, aliwaweka wanawe kuwa waamuzi juu ya Israeli.
sw.R: Samweli alipozeeka, aliwafanya wanawe kuwa waamuzi wa kuwaongoza Israeli.

vi.L: Khi Sa-mu-ên đã già, người lập các con trai mình làm quan xét trên Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Khi về già, Sa-mu-ên lập các con trai mình làm quan xét cho Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Khi Sa-mu-ên đã già, người lập các con trai mình làm thủ lĩnh để lãnh đạo Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 사무엘이 늙었을 때, 그는 자기 아들들을 이스라엘의 사사로 세웠다.
ko.B: 사무엘은 늙자 자기 아들들을 이스라엘의 사사로 세웠다.
ko.R: 사무엘은 늙자 자기 아들들을 사사로 세워 이스라엘을 이끌게 했다.

pt.L: E aconteceu que, quando Samuel envelheceu, ele constituiu os seus filhos juízes sobre Israel.
pt.B: Quando ficou velho, Samuel nomeou os seus filhos juízes sobre Israel.
pt.R: Quando Samuel ficou velho, ele fez dos seus filhos juízes para liderar Israel.

am.L: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ሳሙኤል በሸመገለ ጊዜ ልጆቹን በእስራኤል ላይ መሳፍንት አደረጋቸው።
am.B: ሳሙኤል በሸመገለ ጊዜ ልጆቹን በእስራኤል ላይ መሳፍንት አድርጎ ሾማቸው።

hi.L: और ऐसा हुआ, जब शमूएल बूढ़ा हुआ, तब उसने अपने पुत्रों को इस्राएल पर न्यायी ठहराया।
hi.B: बुढ़ापे में शमूएल ने अपने पुत्रों को इस्राएल पर न्यायी नियुक्त किया।
hi.R: जब शमूएल बूढ़ा हो गया, तो उसने अपने बेटों को न्यायी बनाया कि वे इस्राएल की अगुवाई करें।

ru.L: И было: когда Самуил состарился, он поставил своих сыновей судьями над Израилем.
ru.B: В старости Самуил поставил своих сыновей судьями над Израилем.
ru.R: Когда Самуил состарился, он сделал своих сыновей судьями, чтобы они руководили Израилем.

ja.L: そして、サムエルが年老いたとき、彼は自分の息子たちをイスラエルの士師とした。
ja.B: サムエルは年老いると、息子たちをイスラエルの士師に任じた。
ja.R: サムエルは年を取ったので、息子たちを、イスラエルを導く士師にしました。

uk.L: І сталося, коли постарів Самуїл, він поставив своїх синів суддями над Ізраїлем.
uk.B: На старість Самуїл поставив своїх синів суддями над Ізраїлем.
uk.R: Коли Самуїл постарів, він зробив своїх синів суддями, щоб вони провадили Ізраїль.

id.L: Dan terjadilah, ketika Samuel sudah tua, dia mengangkat anak-anaknya menjadi hakim atas Israel.
id.B: Ketika Samuel sudah tua, dia mengangkat anak-anaknya menjadi hakim atas Israel.
id.R: Ketika Samuel sudah tua, dia mengangkat anak-anaknya menjadi hakim untuk memimpin Israel.

tl.L: At nangyari, nang matanda na si Samuel, na ginawa niyang mga hukom sa Israel ang kaniyang mga anak.
tl.B: Nang tumanda si Samuel, hinirang niya ang kaniyang mga anak bilang mga hukom sa Israel.
tl.R: Nang tumanda na si Samuel, ginawa niyang mga hukom ang kaniyang mga anak upang mamuno sa Israel.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਇਉਂ ਹੋਇਆ ਕਿ ਸਮੂਏਲ ਦੇ ਬੁੱਢੇ ਹੋਣ ਤੇ, ਉਸ ਨੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਪੁੱਤਰ ਇਸਰਾਏਲ ਉੱਤੇ ਨਿਆਂਕਾਰ ਠਹਿਰਾਏ।
pa.B: ਬੁਢਾਪੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਮੂਏਲ ਨੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਪੁੱਤਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਇਸਰਾਏਲ ਦੇ ਨਿਆਂਕਾਰ ਥਾਪ ਦਿੱਤਾ।
pa.R: ਬਿਰਧ ਹੋਣ ਤੇ ਸਮੂਏਲ ਨੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਪੁੱਤਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਇਸਰਾਏਲ ਦੀ ਅਗਵਾਈ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਨਿਆਂਕਾਰ ਬਣਾ ਦਿੱਤਾ।

decisions.choice: judges: leaders who governed Israel and settled its disputes
decisions.reason: The judges of the book of Judges were leaders raised up to rescue and govern Israel (Judges 2:16-18). Samuel himself judged Israel all his life, going round a circuit of towns (7:15-17). Here the word names the same kind of leadership, given to Samuel's sons.

decisions.choice: Samuel was old: he passed his leadership on to his sons
decisions.reason: Judges were raised up one by one, not by inheritance. Gideon refused to found a line of rulers (Judges 8:22-23). By appointing his sons, Samuel makes leadership pass within a family, and his age is the reason the elders give for asking for a king (verse 5).

decisions.choice: judges to lead Israel
decisions.reason: As in Judges, Readable adds "lead" so that "judges" is not taken to mean only judges in a law court.

decisions.choice: waamuzi
decisions.reason: The leaders of the book of Judges are "waamuzi" at every level, the Swahili name for that office; "mahakimu" would make them court magistrates only (m1).

decisions.choice: "quan xét" for the judges (Literal, Balanced); "thủ lĩnh" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Leaders who governed and settled disputes (meaning decision); the word follows Joshua–Ruth: "quan xét" (Literal, Balanced), the name of the office in Judges and Acts 13:20, and "thủ lĩnh" (Readable); "thẩm phán" would suggest a law court.

decisions.choice: "사사"
decisions.reason: The judges led Israel and settled its disputes (m1); "사사", the title of the book of Judges, says both, while "재판관" says only the court.

decisions.choice: Narration plain ("とした", "任じた") at Literal and Balanced, です・ます ("しました") at Readable; light respect forms for God only, as Judges and 1 Samuel 1-7
decisions.reason: Book-wide register choice, kept from the Japanese of Joshua and Judges.

decisions.choice: "士師" at every level, Readable "イスラエルを導く士師"
decisions.reason: The term Judges and ACT 13:20 use for the shofetim; Readable glosses what they did, as the English "to lead Israel".

decisions.choice: "mga hukom"
decisions.reason: Leaders who governed Israel and settled its disputes (m1).

decisions.choice: "nang matanda na si Samuel"
decisions.reason: He passed his leadership on to his sons (m2).

source.text: וַיְהִ֞י שֶׁם־בְּנ֤וֹ הַבְּכוֹר֙ יוֹאֵ֔ל וְשֵׁ֥ם מִשְׁנֵ֖הוּ אֲבִיָּ֑ה שֹׁפְטִ֖ים בִּבְאֵ֥ר שָֽׁבַע׃

records.literal_gloss: And was [the] name of his son the firstborn Joel, and [the] name of his second Abijah; judges in Beersheba.

en.L: And the name of his firstborn son was Joel, and the name of his second [was] Abijah; [they were] judges in Beersheba.
en.B: His firstborn son was named Joel, and his second Abijah. They served as judges in Beersheba.
en.R: His oldest son was named Joel, and his second son was Abijah. They were judges in the town of Beersheba.

es.L: Y el nombre de su hijo primogénito era Joel, y el nombre del segundo [era] Abías; [eran] jueces en Beerseba.
es.B: Su hijo primogénito se llamaba Joel, y el segundo Abías. Ejercían como jueces en Beerseba.
es.R: Su hijo mayor se llamaba Joel, y el segundo, Abías. Eran jueces en la ciudad de Beerseba.

fr.L: Et le nom de son fils premier-né était Joël, et le nom de son second, Abiya ; [ils étaient] juges à Beer-Shéba.
fr.B: Son fils aîné s’appelait Joël, et le second Abiya. Ils exerçaient la fonction de juges à Beer-Shéba.
fr.R: Son fils aîné s’appelait Joël, et son deuxième fils Abiya. Ils étaient juges dans la ville de Beer-Shéba.

sw.L: Na jina la mwanawe mzaliwa wa kwanza lilikuwa Yoeli, na jina la wa pili [lilikuwa] Abiya; [walikuwa] waamuzi huko Beer-sheba.
sw.B: Mwanawe mzaliwa wa kwanza aliitwa Yoeli, na wa pili Abiya. Walihudumu kama waamuzi huko Beer-sheba.
sw.R: Mwanawe mkubwa aliitwa Yoeli, na mwanawe wa pili aliitwa Abiya. Walikuwa waamuzi katika mji wa Beer-sheba.

vi.L: Tên của con trưởng nam người là Giô-ên, và tên của con thứ hai [là] A-bi-gia; [họ là] quan xét tại Bê-e-Sê-ba.
vi.B: Con trưởng nam của người tên là Giô-ên, con thứ hai tên là A-bi-gia. Họ làm quan xét tại Bê-e-Sê-ba.
vi.R: Con trai cả của người tên là Giô-ên, con trai thứ hai là A-bi-gia. Họ làm thủ lĩnh tại thị trấn Bê-e-Sê-ba.

ko.L: 그리고 그의 맏아들의 이름은 요엘이고, 그의 둘째의 이름은 아비야였다. [그들은] 브엘세바에서 사사였다.
ko.B: 그의 맏아들의 이름은 요엘이고, 둘째의 이름은 아비야였다. 그들은 브엘세바에서 사사로 일했다.
ko.R: 사무엘의 맏아들은 요엘이었고, 둘째 아들은 아비야였다. 그들은 브엘세바라는 성읍에서 사사로 일했다.

pt.L: E o nome do seu filho primogênito era Joel, e o nome do segundo, Abias; [eram] juízes em Berseba.
pt.B: O seu filho primogênito se chamava Joel, e o segundo, Abias. Eles atuavam como juízes em Berseba.
pt.R: O filho mais velho dele se chamava Joel, e o segundo se chamava Abias. Eles eram juízes na cidade de Berseba.

am.L: የበኩር ልጁም ስም ኢዮኤል ነበረ፤ የሁለተኛውም ስም አብያ [ነበረ]፤ በቤርሳቤህ መሳፍንት [ነበሩ]።
am.B: የበኩር ልጁ ስም ኢዮኤል፣ የሁለተኛው ልጁ ስም ደግሞ አብያ ነበረ። እነርሱም በቤርሳቤህ መሳፍንት ሆነው ያገለግሉ ነበር።
am.R: የመጀመሪያ ልጁ ስም ኢዮኤል፣ የሁለተኛው ልጁ ስም ደግሞ አብያ ነበረ። እነርሱም ቤርሳቤህ በምትባለው ከተማ መሪዎች ነበሩ።

hi.L: और उसके पहलौठे पुत्र का नाम योएल, और उसके दूसरे का नाम अबिय्याह [था]; [वे] बेर्शेबा में न्यायी [थे]।
hi.B: उसके पहलौठे पुत्र का नाम योएल था, और दूसरे का अबिय्याह। वे बेर्शेबा में न्यायी थे।

ru.L: И имя его первенца было Иоиль, а имя второго — Авия; [они были] судьями в Беэр-Шеве.
ru.B: Его первенца звали Иоиль, а второго — Авия. Они были судьями в Беэр-Шеве.
ru.R: Старшего сына звали Иоиль, а второго сына — Авия. Они были судьями в городе Беэр-Шеве.

ja.L: その長子の名はヨエル、その次の[子]の名はアビヤであった。[彼らは]ベエル・シェバで士師であった。
ja.B: 長子の名はヨエル、次男の名はアビヤといい、二人はベエル・シェバで士師を務めた。
ja.R: いちばん上の息子の名前はヨエル、二番目の息子の名前はアビヤでした。二人はベエル・シェバの町で士師をしていました。

uk.L: І було імʼя його первістка Йоїл, а імʼя його другого — Авія; [вони були] суддями в Беер-Шеві.
uk.B: Його первістка звали Йоїл, а другого — Авія. Вони були суддями в Беер-Шеві.
uk.R: Його старшого сина звали Йоїл, а другого — Авія. Вони були суддями в місті Беер-Шеві.

id.L: Dan nama anaknya yang sulung ialah Yoel, dan nama anaknya yang kedua Abia; [mereka menjadi] hakim di Bersyeba.
id.B: Nama anaknya yang sulung ialah Yoel, dan nama anaknya yang kedua Abia. Mereka menjadi hakim di Bersyeba.
id.R: Anaknya yang sulung bernama Yoel, dan anaknya yang kedua bernama Abia. Mereka menjadi hakim di kota Bersyeba.

tl.L: At ang pangalan ng kaniyang panganay na anak ay Joel, at ang pangalan ng kaniyang ikalawa [ay] Abias; [sila ay] mga hukom sa Beer-seba.
tl.B: Joel ang pangalan ng kaniyang panganay na anak, at Abias ang ikalawa. Naglingkod sila bilang mga hukom sa Beer-seba.
tl.R: Joel ang pangalan ng kaniyang panganay, at Abias ang kaniyang ikalawang anak. Mga hukom sila sa bayan ng Beer-seba.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਪਹਿਲੌਠੇ ਪੁੱਤਰ ਦਾ ਨਾਂ ਯੋਏਲ ਸੀ, ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਦੂਜੇ ਦਾ ਨਾਂ ਅਬੀਯਾਹ; [ਉਹ] ਬਏਰਸ਼ਬਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਿਆਂਕਾਰ [ਸਨ]।
pa.B: ਉਸ ਦੇ ਪਹਿਲੌਠੇ ਦਾ ਨਾਂ ਯੋਏਲ ਅਤੇ ਦੂਜੇ ਦਾ ਅਬੀਯਾਹ ਸੀ। ਉਹ ਬਏਰਸ਼ਬਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਿਆਂਕਾਰ ਦਾ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਦੇ ਸਨ।
pa.R: ਉਸ ਦੇ ਵੱਡੇ ਪੁੱਤਰ ਦਾ ਨਾਂ ਯੋਏਲ ਸੀ, ਅਤੇ ਦੂਜੇ ਪੁੱਤਰ ਦਾ ਅਬੀਯਾਹ। ਉਹ ਬਏਰਸ਼ਬਾ ਨਗਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਿਆਂਕਾਰ ਸਨ।

decisions.choice: Joel and Abijah: names that confess Yahweh
decisions.reason: Joel means "Yahweh is God" and Abijah "Yahweh is my father". The sons bear names of faith, which makes their conduct in verse 3 all the sadder.

decisions.choice: Beersheba: a town in the far south of the land
decisions.reason: Beersheba lay at the southern edge of Israel; "from Dan to Beersheba" means the whole land (3:20). It was far from Ramah, Samuel's home, and from the towns of his own circuit, Bethel, Gilgal and Mizpah (7:16-17).

decisions.choice: They served as judges (Balanced); They were judges (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "judges in Beersheba". Balanced and Readable supply a verb to make a full sentence; Readable also says that Beersheba was a town.

decisions.choice: "Joël", "Abiya"
decisions.reason: "Joël" is the established French form; "Abiya" transcribes the name the way the Samuel terms note writes "Benaya" and "Tserouya", keeping the ending "-ya" that names Yahweh (m1).

decisions.choice: "Giô-ên" and "A-bi-gia"
decisions.reason: "Giô-ên" is the form of the Vietnamese Acts 2:16; "A-bi-gia" the usual Protestant form, also in Luke 1:5.

decisions.choice: Joel; Abias; Berseba
decisions.reason: "Abias" is the Brazilian form of the name, as in Matthew 1:7 and Luke 1:5; "Berseba" as Genesis 21.

decisions.choice: "ヨエル", "アビヤ"; Beersheba "ベエル・シェバ" as Genesis and Joshua
decisions.reason: Standard transcriptions of the Hebrew names; the town keeps its Pentateuch form.

decisions.choice: "Йоїл", "Авія"
decisions.reason: Joel keeps the form of the prophet's name, Abijah the form of Matthew 1:7.

decisions.choice: "Yoel", "Abia", "Bersyeba"
decisions.reason: The glossary forms (the prophet Joel, King Abijah, Beersheba), one spelling for a name shared by several people.

decisions.choice: "Joel ... Abias"
decisions.reason: Names that confess Yahweh (m1).

decisions.choice: "Beer-seba"
decisions.reason: A town in the far south of the land (m2).

source.text: וְלֹֽא־הָלְכ֤וּ בָנָיו֙ בִּדְרָכָ֔יו וַיִּטּ֖וּ אַחֲרֵ֣י הַבָּ֑צַע וַיִּ֨קְחוּ־שֹׁ֔חַד וַיַּטּ֖וּ מִשְׁפָּֽט׃פ

records.literal_gloss: But not walked his sons in his ways, and they turned aside after the gain, and took a bribe, and turned aside justice.

en.L: But his sons did not walk in his ways, and they turned aside after gain, and took bribes, and turned aside justice.
en.B: But his sons did not follow his ways. They turned aside after dishonest gain; they took bribes and bent justice.
en.R: But Samuel's sons did not live the way their father did. They were greedy for money. They took bribes and made unfair decisions.

es.L: Pero sus hijos no anduvieron en sus caminos, sino que se desviaron tras la ganancia, y aceptaron soborno, y torcieron el derecho.
es.B: Pero sus hijos no siguieron sus pasos. Se desviaron tras las ganancias deshonestas; aceptaban sobornos y torcían la justicia.
es.R: Pero los hijos de Samuel no vivían como su padre. Eran codiciosos. Aceptaban sobornos y tomaban decisiones injustas.

fr.L: Mais ses fils ne marchèrent pas dans ses voies ; ils se détournèrent vers le profit, et ils prirent des pots-de-vin, et ils firent dévier le droit.
fr.B: Mais ses fils ne suivirent pas son exemple. Ils se laissèrent attirer par le gain malhonnête, acceptèrent des pots-de-vin et faussèrent la justice.
fr.R: Mais les fils de Samuel ne vivaient pas comme leur père. Ils aimaient trop l’argent. Ils acceptaient des cadeaux pour favoriser quelqu’un et rendaient des jugements injustes.

sw.L: Lakini wanawe hawakutembea katika njia zake, bali walikengeuka wakifuata faida, wakapokea rushwa, wakapotosha haki.
sw.B: Lakini wanawe hawakufuata njia zake. Walikengeuka wakitafuta faida isiyo halali; walipokea rushwa na kupotosha haki.
sw.R: Lakini wana wa Samweli hawakuishi kama baba yao alivyoishi. Walikuwa na tamaa ya fedha. Walipokea rushwa na kutoa hukumu zisizo za haki.

vi.L: Nhưng các con trai người không bước đi trong đường lối người; họ chạy theo lợi lộc, nhận hối lộ và làm sai lệch công lý.
vi.B: Nhưng các con trai người không noi theo đường lối người. Họ chạy theo lợi bất chính, nhận hối lộ và bẻ cong công lý.
vi.R: Nhưng các con trai của Sa-mu-ên không sống như cha mình. Họ tham tiền. Họ nhận hối lộ và xử kiện bất công.

ko.L: 그러나 그의 아들들은 그의 길로 걷지 않고, 이익을 따라 빗나가서 뇌물을 받고 정의를 굽게 했다.
ko.B: 그러나 그의 아들들은 아버지의 길을 따르지 않았다. 그들은 부정한 이익을 좇아 뇌물을 받고 재판을 굽게 했다.
ko.R: 그러나 사무엘의 아들들은 아버지처럼 살지 않았다. 그들은 돈 욕심이 많았다. 그들은 뇌물을 받고 불공정하게 판결했다.

pt.L: Mas os seus filhos não andaram nos seus caminhos, e se desviaram atrás do lucro, e aceitaram suborno, e perverteram a justiça.
pt.B: Mas os seus filhos não seguiram os caminhos dele. Desviaram-se atrás de lucro desonesto, aceitaram subornos e torceram a justiça.
pt.R: Mas os filhos de Samuel não viviam como o pai. Eles eram gananciosos. Aceitavam dinheiro por fora e davam sentenças injustas.

am.L: ልጆቹ ግን በመንገዱ አልሄዱም፤ ትርፍንም ተከትለው ፈቀቅ አሉ፤ ጉቦም ተቀበሉ፤ ፍርድንም አጣመሙ።
am.B: ልጆቹ ግን የእርሱን መንገድ አልተከተሉም። ያልተገባ ጥቅምን ተከትለው ፈቀቅ አሉ፤ ጉቦ ተቀበሉ፤ ፍርድንም አጣመሙ።
am.R: የሳሙኤል ልጆች ግን እንደ አባታቸው አልኖሩም። ገንዘብን ይመኙ ነበር። ጉቦ ይቀበሉ ነበር፤ ፍትሕ የጎደለውም ፍርድ ይፈርዱ ነበር።

hi.L: पर उसके पुत्र उसके मार्गों पर न चले, और वे लाभ के पीछे भटक गए, और घूस लेते, और न्याय बिगाड़ते थे।
hi.B: पर उसके पुत्र उसके मार्गों पर नहीं चले। वे बेईमानी की कमाई के पीछे भटक गए; वे घूस लेते और न्याय को टेढ़ा करते थे।
hi.R: पर शमूएल के बेटे अपने पिता की तरह नहीं जीते थे। वे पैसे के लालची थे। वे घूस लेते थे और अन्याय से फ़ैसले करते थे।

ru.L: Но не ходили его сыновья его путями, и уклонились они за корыстью, и брали взятки, и извращали правосудие.
ru.B: Но его сыновья не шли его путями. Они гнались за нечестной наживой, брали взятки и искажали правосудие.
ru.R: Но сыновья Самуила жили не так, как их отец. Они были жадными до денег. Они брали взятки и выносили несправедливые решения.

ja.L: しかし彼の息子たちは彼の道を歩まず、不正な利得を追って[道から]それ、賄賂を取り、裁きを曲げた。
ja.B: しかし息子たちは父の道を歩まなかった。彼らは不正な利益に心を傾け、賄賂を受け取って、裁きを曲げた。
ja.R: ところが、サムエルの息子たちは、父のような生き方をしませんでした。お金をほしがり、わいろを受け取って、不公平な裁きをしました。

uk.L: Але не ходили його сини його дорогами, і звернули вони за наживою, і брали хабар, і викривляли правосуддя.
uk.B: Але його сини не ходили його дорогами. Вони гналися за наживою, брали хабарі й викривляли правосуддя.
uk.R: Але Самуїлові сини жили не так, як їхній батько. Вони були жадібні до грошей. Вони брали хабарі й судили несправедливо.

id.L: Tetapi anak-anaknya tidak hidup menurut jalannya, dan mereka menyimpang mengejar laba, dan menerima suap, dan memutarbalikkan keadilan.
id.B: Tetapi anak-anaknya tidak hidup seperti dia. Mereka mengejar keuntungan, menerima suap, dan memutarbalikkan keadilan.
id.R: Tetapi anak-anak Samuel tidak hidup seperti ayah mereka. Mereka serakah akan uang. Mereka menerima suap dan membuat keputusan yang tidak adil.

tl.L: Ngunit ang kaniyang mga anak ay hindi lumakad sa kaniyang mga daan, at lumihis sila upang sumunod sa pakinabang, at tumanggap ng mga suhol, at binaluktot ang katarungan.
tl.B: Ngunit hindi sumunod ang kaniyang mga anak sa kaniyang mga daan. Lumihis sila upang maghangad ng di-tapat na pakinabang; tumanggap sila ng mga suhol at binaluktot ang katarungan.
tl.R: Ngunit hindi namuhay ang mga anak ni Samuel gaya ng kanilang ama. Sakim sila sa pera. Tumanggap sila ng mga suhol at gumawa ng mga di-makatarungang pasiya.

pa.L: ਪਰ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਪੁੱਤਰ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਰਾਹਾਂ ਉੱਤੇ ਨਾ ਤੁਰੇ, ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਲਾਭ ਦੇ ਪਿੱਛੇ ਮੁੜ ਗਏ, ਅਤੇ ਵੱਢੀ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਸਨ, ਅਤੇ ਨਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਮਰੋੜਦੇ ਸਨ।
pa.B: ਪਰ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਪੁੱਤਰ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਰਾਹਾਂ ਉੱਤੇ ਨਾ ਚੱਲੇ। ਉਹ ਬੇਈਮਾਨੀ ਦੀ ਕਮਾਈ ਵੱਲ ਝੁਕ ਗਏ; ਉਹ ਵੱਢੀ ਖਾਂਦੇ ਅਤੇ ਇਨਸਾਫ਼ ਨੂੰ ਵਿਗਾੜਦੇ ਸਨ।
pa.R: ਪਰ ਸਮੂਏਲ ਦੇ ਪੁੱਤਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਪਿਤਾ ਵਾਂਗ ਨਹੀਂ ਜੀਉਂਦੇ ਸਨ। ਉਹ ਪੈਸੇ ਦੇ ਲੋਭੀ ਸਨ। ਉਹ ਵੱਢੀ ਲੈ ਕੇ ਗ਼ਲਤ ਫ਼ੈਸਲੇ ਕਰਦੇ ਸਨ।

decisions.choice: his sons (the reading the scribes marked)
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) can be read "his son"; the reading the scribes marked in the margin (qere) is "his sons", which the printed text follows. The plural fits the plural verbs and the two sons named in verse 2, so the meaning is the same either way. Reviewers should check this against the Masoretic notes.

decisions.choice: walk in his ways: live as he lived
decisions.reason: A person's "ways" are the conduct of their life. Samuel ruled honestly and could later call the people to witness that he had taken no bribe (12:3-5); his sons did not follow him.

decisions.choice: took a bribe and turned aside justice: the very things the law forbids judges
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 16:19 tells judges, "You shall not turn aside justice ... and you shall not take a bribe" (see also Exodus 23:6-8). The sons break it word for word. The word for justice here returns in verses 9 and 11 for the "way" of the king.

decisions.choice: gain: profit got dishonestly
decisions.reason: The word means profit, often profit gained by violence or fraud. Moses was told to choose judges who hate such gain (Exodus 18:21).

decisions.choice: bent justice (Balanced); made unfair decisions (Readable)
decisions.reason: To "turn aside justice" is to twist a verdict away from what is right. Balanced keeps a picture close to the Hebrew; Readable says what it meant in practice.

decisions.choice: aceitavam dinheiro por fora (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what a bribe is in everyday Brazilian words; Literal and Balanced keep "suborno", the word of Deuteronomy 16:19 that the sons break (m3).

decisions.choice: "ang kaniyang mga anak"
decisions.reason: The reading the scribes marked (m1).

decisions.choice: "lumakad sa kaniyang mga daan"
decisions.reason: Live as he lived (m2).

decisions.choice: "tumanggap ng mga suhol, at binaluktot ang katarungan"
decisions.reason: The very things the law forbids judges (m3).

decisions.choice: "pakinabang"
decisions.reason: Profit got dishonestly (m4).

source.text: וַיִּֽתְקַבְּצ֔וּ כֹּ֖ל זִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל הָרָמָֽתָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And gathered themselves all [the] elders of Israel and came to Samuel to Ramah.

en.L: And all the elders of Israel gathered together and came to Samuel at Ramah.
en.B: So all the elders of Israel came together and went to Samuel at Ramah.
en.R: So all the leaders of Israel met together and went to see Samuel at his home in Ramah.

es.L: Y se reunieron todos los ancianos de Israel y vinieron a Samuel en Ramá.
es.B: Entonces todos los ancianos de Israel se reunieron y fueron a ver a Samuel en Ramá.
es.R: Entonces todos los líderes de Israel se reunieron y fueron a ver a Samuel a su casa en Ramá.

fr.L: Et tous les anciens d’Israël se rassemblèrent et vinrent vers Samuel à Rama.
fr.B: Alors tous les anciens d’Israël se réunirent et allèrent trouver Samuel à Rama.
fr.R: Alors tous les responsables d’Israël se sont réunis et sont allés voir Samuel chez lui, à Rama.

sw.L: Na wazee wote wa Israeli wakakusanyika, wakamjia Samweli huko Rama.
sw.B: Basi wazee wote wa Israeli wakakusanyika pamoja, wakaenda kwa Samweli huko Rama.
sw.R: Basi viongozi wote wa Israeli wakakutana pamoja, wakaenda kumwona Samweli nyumbani kwake huko Rama.

vi.L: Tất cả các trưởng lão Y-sơ-ra-ên nhóm họp lại và đến cùng Sa-mu-ên tại Ra-ma.
vi.B: Vậy tất cả các trưởng lão Y-sơ-ra-ên họp nhau lại và đến gặp Sa-mu-ên tại Ra-ma.
vi.R: Vậy tất cả các nhà lãnh đạo Y-sơ-ra-ên họp lại và đến gặp Sa-mu-ên tại nhà người ở Ra-ma.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘의 모든 장로가 모여서 라마에 있는 사무엘에게 왔다.
ko.B: 그래서 이스라엘의 모든 장로가 모여 라마에 있는 사무엘에게 갔다.
ko.R: 그래서 이스라엘의 모든 지도자가 모여서 라마에 있는 사무엘의 집으로 찾아갔다.

pt.L: E todos os anciãos de Israel se reuniram e foram a Samuel, em Ramá.
pt.B: Então todos os anciãos de Israel se reuniram e foram falar com Samuel, em Ramá.
pt.R: Então todos os líderes de Israel se reuniram e foram falar com Samuel, na casa dele, em Ramá.

am.L: የእስራኤልም ሽማግሌዎች ሁሉ ተሰበሰቡ፤ ወደ ራማም ወደ ሳሙኤል መጡ።
am.B: ስለዚህ የእስራኤል ሽማግሌዎች ሁሉ ተሰብስበው በራማ ወዳለው ወደ ሳሙኤል መጡ።
am.R: ስለዚህ የእስራኤል ሽማግሌዎች ሁሉ ተሰበሰቡ፤ ሳሙኤልንም ለማየት ራማ ወዳለው ወደ ቤቱ ሄዱ።

hi.L: तब इस्राएल के सब पुरनिए इकट्ठे हुए और रामा में शमूएल के पास आए।
hi.B: तब इस्राएल के सब बुज़ुर्ग अगुवे इकट्ठे होकर रामा में शमूएल के पास गए।
hi.R: तब इस्राएल के सब बुज़ुर्ग अगुवे इकट्ठे हुए और रामा में शमूएल के घर उससे मिलने गए।

ru.L: И собрались все старейшины Израиля и пришли к Самуилу в Раму.
ru.B: Тогда все старейшины Израиля собрались вместе и пришли к Самуилу в Раму.
ru.R: Тогда все вожди Израиля собрались и пошли к Самуилу домой, в Раму.

ja.L: そしてイスラエルの長老たちは皆集まって、ラマのサムエルのもとに来た。
ja.B: そこで、イスラエルの長老たちは皆集まり、ラマにいるサムエルのもとに来た。
ja.R: そこで、イスラエルの指導者たちはみな集まって、ラマにあるサムエルの家に行きました。

uk.L: І зібралися всі старійшини Ізраїлю, і прийшли до Самуїла в Раму.
uk.B: Тож усі старійшини Ізраїлю зібралися й прийшли до Самуїла в Раму.
uk.R: Тож усі провідники Ізраїлю зібралися разом і прийшли до Самуїла додому, в Раму.

id.L: Lalu semua tua-tua Israel berkumpul dan datang kepada Samuel di Rama.
id.B: Lalu semua tua-tua Israel berkumpul dan datang menemui Samuel di Rama.
id.R: Jadi semua pemimpin Israel berkumpul dan pergi menemui Samuel di rumahnya di Rama.

tl.L: At nagtipon ang lahat ng matatanda ng Israel at pumunta kay Samuel sa Rama.
tl.B: Kaya nagtipon ang lahat ng matatanda ng Israel at pumunta kay Samuel sa Rama.
tl.R: Kaya nagpulong ang lahat ng pinuno ng Israel at pinuntahan si Samuel sa kaniyang tahanan sa Rama.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਇਸਰਾਏਲ ਦੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਬਜ਼ੁਰਗ ਇਕੱਠੇ ਹੋਏ ਅਤੇ ਰਾਮਾਹ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਮੂਏਲ ਦੇ ਕੋਲ ਆਏ।
pa.B: ਸੋ ਇਸਰਾਏਲ ਦੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਬਜ਼ੁਰਗ ਆਗੂ ਜੁੜ ਕੇ ਰਾਮਾਹ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਮੂਏਲ ਕੋਲ ਗਏ।
pa.R: ਸੋ ਇਸਰਾਏਲ ਦੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਬਜ਼ੁਰਗ ਆਗੂ ਮਿਲ ਕੇ ਰਾਮਾਹ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਮੂਏਲ ਦੇ ਘਰ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਮਿਲਣ ਗਏ।

decisions.choice: the elders of Israel: the heads of families and clans who spoke for the people
decisions.reason: The elders were senior men who led their clans and acted for the nation as a whole (4:3; Exodus 3:16). Their coming together shows that the request is the people's considered decision, not a passing complaint.

decisions.choice: Ramah: Samuel's home town
decisions.reason: Samuel was born in Ramah (1:1, 19), lived there and built an altar there, and judged Israel from it (7:17).

decisions.choice: leaders; at his home in Ramah
decisions.reason: Readable says "leaders" for "elders", since the word here is about their position, not their age, and adds that Ramah was Samuel's home (see m2).

decisions.choice: "matatanda ng Israel"
decisions.reason: The heads of families and clans who spoke for the people (m1).

decisions.choice: "Rama"
decisions.reason: Samuel's home town (m2).

source.text: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֗יו הִנֵּה֙ אַתָּ֣ה זָקַ֔נְתָּ וּבָנֶ֕יךָ לֹ֥א הָלְכ֖וּ בִּדְרָכֶ֑יךָ עַתָּ֗ה שִֽׂימָה־לָּ֥נוּ מֶ֛לֶךְ לְשָׁפְטֵ֖נוּ כְּכָל־הַגּוֹיִֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they said to him, Look, you are old, and your sons not walk in your ways; now appoint for us a king to judge us like all the nations.

en.L: And they said to him, "Look, you are old, and your sons do not walk in your ways. Now appoint for us a king to judge us, like all the nations."
en.B: They said to him, "You are old, and your sons do not follow your ways. So now appoint a king to judge us, as all the nations have."
en.R: They said to him, "You are old now, and your sons do not live the way you do. So choose a king to lead us, just as all the other nations have."

es.L: Y le dijeron: «Mira, tú has envejecido, y tus hijos no andan en tus caminos. Ahora, pon sobre nosotros un rey que nos juzgue, como todas las naciones».
es.B: Le dijeron: «Tú ya eres anciano, y tus hijos no siguen tus pasos. Así que nombra ahora un rey que nos juzgue, como lo tienen todas las naciones».
es.R: Le dijeron: «Ya eres viejo, y tus hijos no viven como tú. Así que escoge un rey que nos gobierne, como lo tienen todas las demás naciones».

fr.L: Et ils lui dirent : « Voici, tu es vieux, et tes fils ne marchent pas dans tes voies. Maintenant, établis sur nous un roi pour nous juger, comme toutes les nations. »
fr.B: Ils lui dirent : « Tu es vieux, et tes fils ne suivent pas ton exemple. Établis donc maintenant sur nous un roi pour nous gouverner, comme en ont toutes les nations. »
fr.R: Ils lui ont dit : « Tu es vieux maintenant, et tes fils ne vivent pas comme toi. Alors choisis un roi pour nous diriger, comme toutes les autres nations en ont un. »

sw.L: Nao wakamwambia, "Tazama, wewe umezeeka, na wanao hawatembei katika njia zako. Basi sasa tuwekee mfalme atuhukumu, kama mataifa yote."
sw.B: Wakamwambia, "Wewe umezeeka, na wanao hawafuati njia zako. Basi sasa tuwekee mfalme atuamue, kama mataifa yote yalivyo nao."
sw.R: Wakamwambia, "Sasa wewe ni mzee, na wanao hawaishi kama wewe. Kwa hiyo tuchagulie mfalme atuongoze, kama mataifa mengine yote yalivyo nao."

vi.L: Họ nói với người: "Kìa, ông đã già, và các con trai ông không bước đi trong đường lối ông. Vậy bây giờ xin ông lập cho chúng tôi một vua để xét xử chúng tôi, như mọi dân tộc."
vi.B: Họ nói với người: "Ông đã già, còn các con trai ông không noi theo đường lối ông. Vậy bây giờ xin ông lập một vua để xét xử chúng tôi, như các dân tộc khác."
vi.R: Họ nói với người: "Ông bây giờ đã già, còn các con trai ông không sống như ông. Vậy xin ông chọn một vua để lãnh đạo chúng tôi, như tất cả các dân tộc khác."

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 그에게 말했다. "보십시오, 당신은 늙었고, 당신의 아들들은 당신의 길로 걷지 않습니다. 이제 모든 민족처럼 우리를 다스릴 왕을 우리에게 세워 주십시오."
ko.B: 그들이 사무엘에게 말했다. "어른께서는 늙으셨고, 아드님들은 어른의 길을 따르지 않습니다. 그러니 이제 다른 모든 민족처럼 우리를 다스릴 왕을 세워 주십시오."
ko.R: 그들이 사무엘에게 말했다. "어른께서는 이제 늙으셨습니다. 그런데 아드님들은 어른처럼 살지 않습니다. 그러니 다른 모든 민족처럼 우리를 이끌 왕을 뽑아 주십시오."

pt.L: E disseram a ele: "Eis que o senhor está velho, e os seus filhos não andam nos seus caminhos. Agora constitua-nos um rei, para que nos julgue, como todas as nações."
pt.B: Eles lhe disseram: "O senhor está velho, e os seus filhos não seguem os seus caminhos. Agora, então, constitua-nos um rei, para que nos julgue, como têm todas as nações."
pt.R: Eles disseram a Samuel: "O senhor já está velho, e os seus filhos não vivem como o senhor. Por isso, escolha um rei para nos liderar, como todas as outras nações têm."

am.L: እንዲህም አሉት፦ «እነሆ፣ እርስዎ አርጅተዋል፤ ልጆችዎም በመንገድዎ አይሄዱም። አሁንም እንደ ሕዝቦች ሁሉ የሚዳኘን ንጉሥ ያቁሙልን።»
am.B: እንዲህም አሉት፦ «እርስዎ አርጅተዋል፤ ልጆችዎም የእርስዎን መንገድ አይከተሉም። ስለዚህ አሁን ሕዝቦች ሁሉ እንዳላቸው የሚያስተዳድረን ንጉሥ ይሹሙልን።»
am.R: እንዲህም አሉት፦ «እርስዎ አሁን አርጅተዋል፤ ልጆችዎም እንደ እርስዎ አይኖሩም። ስለዚህ ሌሎቹ ሕዝቦች ሁሉ እንዳላቸው የሚመራን ንጉሥ ይምረጡልን።»

hi.L: और उन्होंने उससे कहा, "देखिए, आप बूढ़े हो गए हैं, और आपके पुत्र आपके मार्गों पर नहीं चलते। अब सब जातियों के समान हमारा न्याय करने के लिए हम पर एक राजा नियुक्त कीजिए।"
hi.B: उन्होंने उससे कहा, "आप बूढ़े हो गए हैं, और आपके पुत्र आपके मार्गों पर नहीं चलते। इसलिए अब हमारा न्याय करने के लिए एक राजा नियुक्त कीजिए, जैसा सब देशों में होता है।"
hi.R: उन्होंने उससे कहा, "अब आप बूढ़े हो गए हैं, और आपके बेटे आपकी तरह नहीं जीते। इसलिए हमारी अगुवाई करने के लिए एक राजा चुन दीजिए, जैसे दूसरे सब देशों के पास है।"

ru.L: И сказали ему: «Вот, ты стар, и сыновья твои не ходят твоими путями. Теперь назначь нам царя, чтобы судить нас, как все народы.»
ru.B: Они сказали ему: «Ты стар, и твои сыновья не идут твоими путями. Так поставь же над нами царя, чтобы он судил нас, как это у всех народов.»
ru.R: Они сказали ему: «Ты уже стар, а твои сыновья живут не так, как ты. Поэтому выбери нам царя, чтобы он руководил нами, как у всех других народов.»

ja.L: そして彼らは彼に言った。「ご覧ください。あなたは年老い、あなたの息子たちはあなたの道を歩んでいません。今、すべての国々のように、わたしたちを裁く王を、わたしたちのために立ててください。」
ja.B: 彼らはサムエルに言った。「あなたはもう年老いて、息子さんたちはあなたの道を歩んでいません。ですから今、ほかのすべての国々のように、わたしたちを裁き治める王を立ててください。」
ja.R: 彼らはサムエルに言いました。「あなたはもうお年です。それに、息子さんたちはあなたのような生き方をしていません。ですから、ほかの国々と同じように、わたしたちを導く王を選んでください。」

uk.L: І сказали йому: «Ось ти постарів, а твої сини не ходять твоїми дорогами. Тепер постав нам царя, щоб судив нас, як [у] всіх народів.»
uk.B: Вони сказали йому: «Ти вже старий, а твої сини не ходять твоїми дорогами. Тож постав нам царя, щоб він судив нас, як це є в усіх народів.»
uk.R: Вони сказали йому: «Ти вже старий, а твої сини живуть не так, як ти. Тож вибери нам царя, щоб він провадив нас, як у всіх інших народів.»

id.L: Dan mereka berkata kepadanya, "Lihatlah, Bapak sudah tua, dan anak-anak Bapak tidak hidup menurut jalan Bapak. Sekarang angkatlah bagi kami seorang raja untuk memerintah kami, seperti semua bangsa lain."
id.B: Mereka berkata kepadanya, "Bapak sudah tua, dan anak-anak Bapak tidak hidup seperti Bapak. Karena itu, angkatlah seorang raja untuk memerintah kami, seperti pada semua bangsa lain."
id.R: Mereka berkata kepadanya, "Bapak sudah tua, dan anak-anak Bapak tidak hidup seperti Bapak. Jadi pilihlah seorang raja untuk memimpin kami, seperti yang dimiliki semua bangsa lain."

tl.L: At sinabi nila sa kaniya, "Narito, matanda ka na, at ang iyong mga anak ay hindi lumalakad sa iyong mga daan. Ngayon ay humirang ka para sa amin ng isang hari upang humatol sa amin, gaya ng lahat ng bansa."
tl.B: Sinabi nila sa kaniya, "Matanda ka na po, at hindi sumusunod ang iyong mga anak sa iyong mga daan. Kaya ngayon ay humirang ka po ng isang hari upang humatol sa amin, gaya ng mayroon ang lahat ng bansa."
tl.R: Sinabi nila sa kaniya, "Matanda ka na po, at hindi namumuhay ang iyong mga anak gaya mo. Kaya pumili ka po ng isang hari na mamumuno sa amin, gaya ng lahat ng ibang bansa."

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਆਖਿਆ, "ਵੇਖੋ, ਤੁਸੀਂ ਬੁੱਢੇ ਹੋ ਗਏ ਹੋ, ਅਤੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਪੁੱਤਰ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਰਾਹਾਂ ਉੱਤੇ ਨਹੀਂ ਤੁਰਦੇ। ਹੁਣ ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਕੌਮਾਂ ਵਾਂਗ ਸਾਡਾ ਨਿਆਂ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਸਾਡੇ ਉੱਤੇ ਇੱਕ ਰਾਜਾ ਠਹਿਰਾਓ।"
pa.B: ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਕਿਹਾ, "ਤੁਸੀਂ ਬਿਰਧ ਹੋ ਚੁੱਕੇ ਹੋ, ਅਤੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਪੁੱਤਰ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਰਾਹ ਨਹੀਂ ਚੱਲਦੇ। ਸੋ ਹੁਣ ਸਾਡਾ ਨਿਆਂ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਇੱਕ ਰਾਜਾ ਥਾਪੋ, ਜਿਵੇਂ ਸਾਰੇ ਦੇਸ਼ਾਂ ਦਾ ਹੈ।"
pa.R: ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਕਿਹਾ, "ਹੁਣ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਬੁੱਢੇ ਹੋ ਗਏ ਹੋ, ਅਤੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਪੁੱਤਰ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਵਾਂਗ ਨਹੀਂ ਜੀਉਂਦੇ। ਇਸ ਲਈ ਸਾਡੀ ਅਗਵਾਈ ਲਈ ਇੱਕ ਰਾਜਾ ਚੁਣੋ, ਜਿਵੇਂ ਹੋਰ ਸਾਰੇ ਦੇਸ਼ਾਂ ਕੋਲ ਹੈ।"

decisions.choice: to judge us: to govern and lead us
decisions.reason: The people use the verb that described the judges' work: to rule, settle disputes and lead in war (verse 20). They ask for the same leadership, but from a king and his line.

decisions.choice: a king like all the nations: the request Deuteronomy foresaw
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 17:14 expects Israel to say, "I will set a king over me, like all the nations that are around me." The law allows a king, but only one whom Yahweh chooses and who lives under the law (Deuteronomy 17:15-20). Israel had been called to be set apart from the nations (Leviticus 20:26; Numbers 23:9); now the elders want to be like them.

decisions.choice: look ... now: the request rests on the facts just stated
decisions.reason: "Look" points to Samuel's age and his sons' conduct; "now" draws the conclusion. The elders present their request as the answer to a real problem.

decisions.choice: Look left out (Balanced, Readable); choose a king to lead us (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Look" here only draws attention, which English does by tone. Readable says "lead" for "judge", as in verse 1, and "choose" for "appoint".

decisions.choice: "pour nous juger" (Literal); "pour nous gouverner" (Balanced); "pour nous diriger" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The verb means to govern and lead as well as to settle disputes (m1). French "juger" today means only the second, so Balanced and Readable say what the elders want from a king; Literal keeps "juger", which links the request to the judges of verse 1.

decisions.choice: atuhukumu (L); atuamue (B); atuongoze (R)
decisions.reason: "To judge" here means to govern and lead (m1); the three levels keep the steps used for Samuel's judging (7:15).

decisions.choice: the elders call Samuel "ông" and themselves "chúng tôi"
decisions.reason: Leaders of the people speaking with respect to the old prophet and judge; "ông" is respectful without the court language they ask for.

decisions.choice: The elders call Samuel "어른" with the honorific (B, R); Literal keeps "당신" for the Hebrew "you"
decisions.reason: The elders speak to the aged prophet and judge with full respect; "당신" sounds distant or rude in spoken Korean, so Balanced and Readable use the respectful "어른께서".

decisions.choice: constitua-nos um rei, para que nos julgue, como todas as nações (L, B)
decisions.reason: The elders speak to Samuel with "o senhor" (as the book does for the people to the prophet), so the verb is "constitua", not the "tu" form "constitui". "Para que nos julgue" keeps the judges' verb (m1), which Readable gives as "liderar", as the English does; "como todas as nações" keeps the echo of Deuteronomy 17:14 (m2).

decisions.choice: The elders speak to Samuel with "እርስዎ" ("እርስዎ አርጅተዋል፤ ልጆችዎም", "ያቁሙልን"); so do the people in 7:8 and 12:4-19, and Saul in chapters 9 and 10.
decisions.reason: Samuel is an old man, a prophet and the judge of Israel; the people and the elders speak to him as Amharic speakers speak to an elder they honour. Samuel and God answer with "አንተ" and "እናንተ".

decisions.choice: A king "to judge us": "የሚዳኘን" (L), "የሚያስተዳድረን" (B), "የሚመራን" (R), here and in verses 6 and 20.
decisions.reason: The king is to govern them, not only try their cases (the meaning decision); "የሚፈርድልን" would mean one who rules in their favour. Balanced says the governing plainly.

decisions.choice: the elders say "आप" to Samuel
decisions.reason: The elders speak to the old prophet and judge with the respectful "आप", as the people do in 7:8; Samuel and the LORD speak to the people with "तुम".

decisions.choice: the nations: "सब जातियाँ" (L); "सब देश" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in the New Testament in this translation, Literal keeps "जातियाँ" for the nations, while Balanced and Readable say "देश", since "जाति" in everyday Hindi also means caste. The same in verse 20.

decisions.choice: "царь"; "царствовать" (L, B), "править" (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole of 1 Samuel, as the history note settles: melekh is "царь" and malak "царствовать" at Literal and Balanced; Readable says "править" or "стать царём".

decisions.choice: The elders speak to Samuel in です・ます; hinneh as "ご覧ください" (Literal), left out (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Petitioners to the prophet speak politely; the polite form of hinneh follows the Genesis convention.

decisions.choice: The elders say "Bapak" to Samuel, and Samuel "kalian" to the people; "memerintah" for "to judge" here
decisions.reason: The elders address the old prophet and judge with respect, as Hannah addressed Eli; their "judge us" means to govern (m1), so "memerintah" (L, B) and "memimpin" (R).

decisions.choice: "humatol sa amin"
decisions.reason: To govern and lead us (m1).

decisions.choice: "isang hari ... gaya ng lahat ng bansa"
decisions.reason: The request Deuteronomy foresaw (Deuteronomy 17:14) (m2).

decisions.choice: "Narito ... Ngayon"
decisions.reason: The request rests on the facts just stated (m3).

decisions.choice: "po"
decisions.reason: The elders address Samuel with po at B and R, with singular ka/mo (m3).

decisions.choice: the elders say "ਤੁਸੀਂ" to Samuel
decisions.reason: Respect for the old prophet.

decisions.choice: the nations: "ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਕੌਮਾਂ" (L); "ਸਾਰੇ ਦੇਸ਼" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Goyim, the other peoples around Israel.

source.text: וַיֵּ֤רַע הַדָּבָר֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמְר֔וּ תְּנָה־לָּ֥נוּ מֶ֖לֶךְ לְשָׁפְטֵ֑נוּ וַיִּתְפַּלֵּ֥ל שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל אֶל־יְהוָֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And was evil the thing in [the] eyes of Samuel when they said, Give to us a king to judge us. And prayed Samuel to Yahweh.

en.L: And the thing was evil in the eyes of Samuel when they said, "Give us a king to judge us." And Samuel prayed to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: But Samuel was displeased when they said, "Give us a king to judge us," and he prayed to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Samuel did not like it when they said, "Give us a king to lead us." So he prayed to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y la cosa fue mala a los ojos de Samuel cuando dijeron: «Danos un rey que nos juzgue». Y Samuel oró {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: Pero a Samuel le desagradó que dijeran: «Danos un rey que nos juzgue», y oró {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: A Samuel no le gustó que le dijeran: «Danos un rey que nos gobierne». Así que oró {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et la chose fut mauvaise aux yeux de Samuel, quand ils dirent : « Donne-nous un roi pour nous juger. » Et Samuel pria {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Mais cette demande déplut à Samuel, quand ils dirent : « Donne-nous un roi pour nous gouverner. » Et il pria {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Samuel n’a pas aimé les entendre dire : « Donne-nous un roi pour nous diriger. » Alors il a prié {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na jambo hilo likawa baya machoni pa Samweli waliposema, "Tupe mfalme atuhukumu." Na Samweli akamwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Lakini Samweli hakupendezwa waliposema, "Tupe mfalme atuamue," naye akamwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Samweli hakupenda waliposema, "Tupe mfalme atuongoze." Kwa hiyo akamwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Điều ấy là xấu trong mắt Sa-mu-ên khi họ nói: "Hãy cho chúng tôi một vua để xét xử chúng tôi." Sa-mu-ên cầu nguyện cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Nhưng Sa-mu-ên không hài lòng khi họ nói: "Hãy cho chúng tôi một vua để xét xử chúng tôi," và người cầu nguyện cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Sa-mu-ên không vui khi họ nói: "Hãy cho chúng tôi một vua để lãnh đạo chúng tôi." Vì vậy người cầu nguyện cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 "우리를 다스릴 왕을 우리에게 주십시오" 하고 말했을 때, 그 일이 사무엘의 눈에 악했다. 그래서 사무엘이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기도했다.
ko.B: 그러나 "우리를 다스릴 왕을 주십시오" 하는 그들의 말이 사무엘에게는 못마땅했다. 그래서 사무엘은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기도했다.
ko.R: 그들이 "우리를 이끌 왕을 주십시오" 하고 말하자, 사무엘은 그 말이 싫었다. 그래서 사무엘은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기도했다.

pt.L: E a coisa foi má aos olhos de Samuel, quando disseram: "Dê-nos um rei para que nos julgue." E Samuel orou {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.
pt.B: Mas Samuel não gostou quando disseram: "Dê-nos um rei para que nos julgue", e orou {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.
pt.R: Samuel não gostou quando eles disseram: "Dê-nos um rei para nos liderar." Por isso, ele orou {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.

am.L: «የሚዳኘን ንጉሥ ይስጡን» ባሉ ጊዜ ነገሩ በሳሙኤል ዓይን ክፉ ሆነ። ሳሙኤልም ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸለየ።
am.B: ሳሙኤል ግን፦ «የሚያስተዳድረን ንጉሥ ይስጡን» ባሉት ጊዜ ደስ አላለውም፤ ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም ጸለየ።
am.R: እነርሱ፦ «የሚመራን ንጉሥ ይስጡን» ባሉ ጊዜ ሳሙኤል ደስ አላለውም። ስለዚህ ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸለየ።

hi.L: पर जब उन्होंने कहा, "हमारा न्याय करने के लिए हमें एक राजा दीजिए," तो यह बात शमूएल की दृष्टि में बुरी लगी। और शमूएल ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से प्रार्थना की।
hi.B: पर जब उन्होंने कहा, "हमारा न्याय करने के लिए हमें एक राजा दीजिए," तो शमूएल को यह बुरा लगा, और उसने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से प्रार्थना की।
hi.R: जब उन्होंने कहा, "हमारी अगुवाई के लिए हमें एक राजा दीजिए," तो शमूएल को यह अच्छा नहीं लगा। इसलिए उसने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से प्रार्थना की।

ru.L: И было худо это дело в глазах Самуила, когда они сказали: «Дай нам царя, чтобы он судил нас.» И помолился Самуил {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Но Самуилу не понравилось, что они сказали: «Дай нам царя, чтобы он судил нас», — и он помолился {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Самуилу не понравилось, когда они сказали: «Дай нам царя, чтобы он руководил нами.» Поэтому он помолился {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: しかし、彼らが「わたしたちを裁く王を、わたしたちに与えてください」と言ったとき、そのことはサムエルの目に悪しきことであった。そしてサムエルは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に祈った。
ja.B: 彼らが「わたしたちを裁く王を与えてください」と言ったので、サムエルは不快に思い、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に祈った。
ja.R: 人々が「わたしたちを導く王をください」と言ったので、サムエルはいやな気持ちになりました。そこで、サムエルは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に祈りました。

uk.L: І була ця річ лиха в очах Самуїла, коли вони сказали: «Дай нам царя, щоб судив нас.» І помолився Самуїл {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЕВІ|Ягве}}.
uk.B: Але Самуїлові не сподобалося, що вони сказали: «Дай нам царя, щоб він судив нас», і він помолився {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЕВІ|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Самуїлові не сподобалося, що вони сказали: «Дай нам царя, щоб він провадив нас.» Тож він помолився {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЕВІ|Ягве}}.

id.L: Dan hal itu jahat di mata Samuel, ketika mereka berkata, "Berikanlah kepada kami seorang raja untuk memerintah kami." Lalu Samuel berdoa kepada {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}.
id.B: Permintaan itu tidak menyenangkan hati Samuel, karena mereka berkata, "Berikanlah kepada kami seorang raja untuk memerintah kami." Lalu Samuel berdoa kepada {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}.
id.R: Samuel tidak senang ketika mereka berkata, "Berikanlah kepada kami seorang raja untuk memimpin kami." Jadi dia berdoa kepada {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}.

tl.L: At ang bagay ay masama sa paningin ni Samuel nang sabihin nila, "Bigyan mo kami ng isang hari upang humatol sa amin." At nanalangin si Samuel {{divine_name:sa PANGINOON|kay Yahweh}}.
tl.B: Ngunit hindi ito ikinatuwa ni Samuel nang sabihin nila, "Bigyan mo po kami ng isang hari upang humatol sa amin," at nanalangin siya {{divine_name:sa PANGINOON|kay Yahweh}}.
tl.R: Hindi nagustuhan ni Samuel nang sabihin nila, "Bigyan mo po kami ng isang hari na mamumuno sa amin." Kaya nanalangin siya {{divine_name:sa PANGINOON|kay Yahweh}}.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਜਦੋਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਆਖਿਆ, "ਸਾਡਾ ਨਿਆਂ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਸਾਨੂੰ ਇੱਕ ਰਾਜਾ ਦਿਓ," ਤਾਂ ਇਹ ਗੱਲ ਸਮੂਏਲ ਦੀਆਂ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਬੁਰੀ ਲੱਗੀ। ਅਤੇ ਸਮੂਏਲ ਨੇ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਅੱਗੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਰਥਨਾ ਕੀਤੀ।
pa.B: ਪਰ ਜਦੋਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਕਿਹਾ, "ਸਾਡਾ ਨਿਆਂ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਸਾਨੂੰ ਇੱਕ ਰਾਜਾ ਦਿਓ," ਤਾਂ ਸਮੂਏਲ ਨੂੰ ਇਹ ਚੰਗਾ ਨਾ ਲੱਗਾ, ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਨੇ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਅੱਗੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਰਥਨਾ ਕੀਤੀ।
pa.R: ਜਦੋਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਕਿਹਾ, "ਸਾਡੀ ਅਗਵਾਈ ਲਈ ਸਾਨੂੰ ਇੱਕ ਰਾਜਾ ਦਿਓ," ਤਾਂ ਸਮੂਏਲ ਨੂੰ ਇਹ ਗੱਲ ਪਸੰਦ ਨਾ ਆਈ। ਸੋ ਉਸ ਨੇ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਅੱਗੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਰਥਨਾ ਕੀਤੀ।

decisions.choice: the thing was evil in the eyes of Samuel: it displeased him
decisions.reason: "Evil in the eyes of" means that someone judged a thing bad. The same words describe what displeases Yahweh (Judges 2:11). Samuel is troubled by the request for a king, not only by the remark about his age.

decisions.choice: give us a king: the request in its barest form
decisions.reason: The narrator repeats the people's words in short, with "give" in place of "appoint" (verse 5). What stays is the core of it: a king, to judge them.

decisions.choice: Samuel prayed: he brought the matter to Yahweh
decisions.reason: Samuel is shown as one who prays for Israel (7:5, 8-9; 12:19, 23). He does not answer the elders himself but waits for Yahweh's word.

decisions.choice: was displeased (Balanced); did not like it (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture; Balanced and Readable give its sense in everyday words.

decisions.choice: "ang bagay ay masama sa paningin ni Samuel"
decisions.reason: It displeased him (m1).

decisions.choice: "Bigyan mo kami ng isang hari"
decisions.reason: The request in its barest form (m2).

decisions.choice: "nanalangin si Samuel"
decisions.reason: He brought the matter to Yahweh (m3).

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל שְׁמַע֙ בְּק֣וֹל הָעָ֔ם לְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־יֹאמְר֖וּ אֵלֶ֑יךָ כִּ֣י לֹ֤א אֹֽתְךָ֙ מָאָ֔סוּ כִּֽי־אֹתִ֥י מָאֲס֖וּ מִמְּלֹ֥ךְ עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh to Samuel, Listen to [the] voice of the people in all that they say to you, for not you they have rejected, but me they have rejected from being king over them.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to Samuel, "Listen to the voice of the people in all that they say to you, for they have not rejected you, but they have rejected {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} from being king over them.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Samuel, "Listen to the people in everything they are saying to you. It is not you they have rejected; it is {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} they have rejected as their king.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Samuel, "Do what the people are asking you to do. They have not turned away from you. They have turned away from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. They do not want {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to be their king.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo a Samuel: «Escucha la voz del pueblo en todo lo que te digan, porque no te han rechazado a ti, sino que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} han rechazado a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, para que no reine sobre ellos.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Samuel: «Escucha al pueblo en todo lo que te está diciendo. No es a ti a quien han rechazado; es a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} a quien han rechazado como su rey.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Samuel: «Haz lo que el pueblo te pide. No se han apartado de ti. Se han apartado de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. No quieren que yo sea su rey.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Samuel : « Écoute la voix du peuple dans tout ce qu’ils te diront, car ce n’est pas toi qu’ils ont rejeté, mais c’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qu’ils ont rejeté, pour que je ne règne pas sur eux.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Samuel : « Écoute le peuple dans tout ce qu’il te dit. Ce n’est pas toi qu’ils ont rejeté ; c’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qu’ils ont rejeté comme roi.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit à Samuel : « Fais ce que le peuple te demande. Ce n’est pas de toi qu’ils se détournent. C’est de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. Ils ne veulent plus que je sois leur roi.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Samweli, "Isikilize sauti ya watu katika yote wanayokuambia, kwa maana hawakukataa wewe, bali wamenikataa {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} nisiwe mfalme juu yao.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Samweli, "Wasikilize watu katika kila jambo wanalokuambia. Si wewe waliyekukataa; ni {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} waliyenikataa kuwa mfalme wao.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Samweli, "Fanya kile watu wanachokuomba. Hawajakuacha wewe. Wameniacha {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}. Hawataki niwe mfalme wao.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Sa-mu-ên: "Hãy nghe theo tiếng của dân trong mọi điều họ nói với ngươi, vì không phải họ từ bỏ ngươi, nhưng họ từ bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, không cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm vua trên họ.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Sa-mu-ên: "Hãy nghe theo mọi điều dân chúng nói với con. Không phải họ từ bỏ con, mà chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Đấng họ từ bỏ, không muốn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm vua của họ.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Sa-mu-ên: "Hãy làm theo điều dân chúng xin. Họ không phải từ bỏ con. Họ từ bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Họ không muốn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm vua của họ nữa.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 사무엘에게 말씀하셨다. "백성이 네게 하는 모든 말을 들어주어라. 그들이 버린 것은 네가 아니라, 나를 버려 내가 그들 위에 왕이 되지 못하게 한 것이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 사무엘에게 말씀하셨다. "백성이 네게 하는 말을 모두 들어주어라. 그들이 버린 것은 네가 아니다. 그들은 나를 버려 내가 그들의 왕이 되지 못하게 한 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 사무엘에게 말씀하셨다. "백성이 해 달라는 대로 해 주어라. 그들은 너를 버린 것이 아니다. 그들은 나를 버렸다. 그들은 내가 자기들의 왕이 되는 것을 원하지 않는다.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse a Samuel: "Ouve a voz do povo em tudo o que te disserem, pois não rejeitaram a ti, mas rejeitaram a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, para que eu não reine sobre eles.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} disse a Samuel: "Atende o povo em tudo o que estão te dizendo. Não foi a ti que rejeitaram; foi a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} que rejeitaram como o seu rei.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} disse a Samuel: "Faze o que o povo está te pedindo. Eles não se afastaram de ti. Eles se afastaram de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}. Eles não querem que eu seja o seu rei.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም ሳሙኤልን እንዲህ አለው፦ «ሕዝቡ በሚሉህ ነገር ሁሉ ቃላቸውን ስማ፤ በላያቸው እንዳልነግሥ እኔን ጣሉኝ እንጂ አንተን አልጣሉህምና።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሳሙኤልን እንዲህ አለው፦ «ሕዝቡ የሚሉህን ሁሉ ስማ። የጣሉት አንተን አይደለም፤ ንጉሣቸው እንዳልሆን የጣሉት እኔን ነው።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሳሙኤልን እንዲህ አለው፦ «ሕዝቡ እንድታደርግላቸው የሚጠይቁህን አድርግ። እነርሱ ከአንተ አልራቁም፤ የራቁት ከእኔ ነው። እኔ ንጉሣቸው እንድሆን አይፈልጉም።

hi.L: और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने शमूएल से कहा, "लोग जो कुछ तुमसे कहते हैं, उस सब में उनकी बात सुनो, क्योंकि उन्होंने तुम्हें नहीं, पर मुझे ठुकराया है, कि मैं उन पर राजा न रहूँ।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने शमूएल से कहा, "लोग जो कुछ तुमसे कह रहे हैं, उस सब में उनकी बात मान लो। उन्होंने तुम्हें नहीं ठुकराया; उन्होंने मुझे ठुकराया है कि मैं उनका राजा न रहूँ।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने शमूएल से कहा, "लोग जो माँग रहे हैं, वही करो। उन्होंने तुमसे मुँह नहीं मोड़ा है। उन्होंने मुझसे मुँह मोड़ा है। वे नहीं चाहते कि मैं उनका राजा रहूँ।

ru.L: И сказал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Самуилу: «Слушай голос народа во всём, что они скажут тебе, потому что они отвергли не тебя, а {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} отвергли, [не желая], чтобы {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} был царём над ними.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал Самуилу: «Прислушайся к народу во всём, что они тебе говорят. Не тебя они отвергли — это {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} они отвергли как своего царя.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал Самуилу: «Сделай то, о чём тебя просит народ. Они отвернулись не от тебя. Они отвернулись от {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}. Они не хотят, чтобы {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} был их царём.

ja.L: そして{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はサムエルに言われた。「民があなたに言うすべてのことについて、その声に聞き従いなさい。彼らが退けたのはあなたではない。わたしを退けて、わたしが彼らの上に王であることを拒んだのだ。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はサムエルに言われた。「民があなたに言っていることを、すべて聞き入れなさい。彼らが退けたのはあなたではない。彼らはわたしを退けて、わたしが彼らの王であることを拒んだのだ。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はサムエルに言われました。「民が願っているとおりにしてやりなさい。彼らはあなたに背を向けたのではない。わたしに背を向けたのだ。わたしが彼らの王であることを望んでいないのだ。

uk.L: І сказав {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Самуїлові: «Послухай голосу народу в усьому, що вони кажуть тобі, бо не тебе вони відкинули, а {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}} відкинули, щоб Я не царював над ними.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав Самуїлові: «Послухай народу в усьому, що вони тобі кажуть. Не тебе вони відкинули; це {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}} вони відкинули як свого царя.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав Самуїлові: «Зроби те, про що тебе просить народ. Вони відвернулися не від тебе. Вони відвернулися від {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}. Вони не хочуть, щоб Я був їхнім царем.

id.L: Dan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} berfirman kepada Samuel, "Dengarkanlah suara rakyat itu dalam segala yang mereka katakan kepadamu, sebab bukan engkau yang mereka tolak, tetapi {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}}-lah yang mereka tolak sebagai raja atas mereka.
id.B: {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} berfirman kepada Samuel, "Dengarkanlah permintaan rakyat itu dalam segala yang mereka katakan kepadamu. Bukan engkau yang mereka tolak, tetapi {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}}, supaya {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} jangan menjadi raja atas mereka.
id.R: {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} berfirman kepada Samuel, "Lakukanlah apa yang diminta rakyat itu kepadamu. Mereka tidak menolak kamu. Mereka menolak {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}}. Mereka tidak mau {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} menjadi raja mereka.

tl.L: At sinabi {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}} kay Samuel, "Pakinggan mo ang tinig ng bayan sa lahat ng sinasabi nila sa iyo, sapagkat hindi ikaw ang kanilang itinakwil, kundi ako ang kanilang itinakwil upang hindi maging hari sa kanila.
tl.B: Sinabi {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}} kay Samuel, "Pakinggan mo ang bayan sa lahat ng sinasabi nila sa iyo. Hindi ikaw ang kanilang itinakwil; ako ang kanilang itinakwil bilang kanilang hari.
tl.R: Sinabi {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}} kay Samuel, "Gawin mo ang hinihiling sa iyo ng bayan. Hindi ikaw ang kanilang tinalikuran. Ako ang kanilang tinalikuran. Ayaw nilang ako ang maging hari nila.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਨੇ ਸਮੂਏਲ ਨੂੰ ਆਖਿਆ, "ਜੋ ਕੁਝ ਲੋਕ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ, ਉਸ ਸਭ ਵਿੱਚ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਅਵਾਜ਼ ਸੁਣ, ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਹੀਂ ਠੁਕਰਾਇਆ, ਸਗੋਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਠੁਕਰਾਇਆ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਮੈਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਉੱਤੇ ਰਾਜਾ ਨਾ ਰਹਾਂ।
pa.B: {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਨੇ ਸਮੂਏਲ ਨੂੰ ਕਿਹਾ, "ਜੋ ਕੁਝ ਲੋਕ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਕਹਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ, ਉਸ ਸਭ ਵਿੱਚ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਗੱਲ ਮੰਨ ਲੈ। ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਰੱਦ ਨਹੀਂ ਕੀਤਾ; ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਰਾਜੇ ਵਜੋਂ ਰੱਦ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ।
pa.R: {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਨੇ ਸਮੂਏਲ ਨੂੰ ਕਿਹਾ, "ਲੋਕ ਜੋ ਮੰਗ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ ਉਹੀ ਕਰ। ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੋਂ ਮੂੰਹ ਨਹੀਂ ਮੋੜਿਆ। ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੋਂ ਮੂੰਹ ਮੋੜਿਆ ਹੈ। ਉਹ ਨਹੀਂ ਚਾਹੁੰਦੇ ਕਿ ਮੈਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਾ ਰਾਜਾ ਹੋਵਾਂ।

decisions.choice: listen to the voice of the people: do what they ask
decisions.reason: To "listen to someone's voice" often means to agree to what they ask (Genesis 21:12). Yahweh tells Samuel to give the people a king; the command comes three times (verses 7, 9, 22).

decisions.choice: they have rejected me from being king over them: Yahweh was Israel's king
decisions.reason: Israel's true king was Yahweh (Exodus 15:18; Deuteronomy 33:5). Gideon refused to rule because "Yahweh will rule over you" (Judges 8:23), and Samuel later says the people asked for a king "when Yahweh your God was your king" (12:12). Wanting a king like the nations is a turning away from Yahweh's rule.

decisions.choice: rejected: refused, cast aside
decisions.reason: The verb means to reject with contempt or refuse. It is used of despising Yahweh's laws (Leviticus 26:15), and later of Yahweh's rejecting Saul when Saul had rejected his word (15:23, 26).

decisions.choice: turned away from; do not want me to be their king
decisions.reason: Readable uses plainer words for "rejected" and makes "from being king over them" its own sentence.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}
decisions.reason: Swahili adds the free pronoun "mimi" to the object marker "-ni-" to carry the Hebrew contrast "not you ... but me" (m2); as a free pronoun spoken by God it takes the span.

decisions.choice: God calls Samuel "ngươi" (L) and "con" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the Genesis terms note sets for God speaking to a person: Literal keeps the plain second person, Balanced and Readable the warmth of the relationship.

decisions.choice: God to Samuel with "tu": Ouve, te, ti, Faze
decisions.reason: For the whole book: God speaks to Samuel, as to one person, with "tu" (the Old Testament note and style §4). English has "me" under the deity_pronoun setting; Portuguese gives the stressed "mim" the span.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of 1 Samuel 8.
alternatives: spans like the English ones (verses 7 and 8)
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change in Amharic.

decisions.choice: "rejected" is "ጣሉ" (cast away).
decisions.reason: The verb is about refusing and setting aside (meaning decision m3); "ናቁ" stresses contempt.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span ("मुझे")
alternatives: a capitalised pronoun, as the English "Me"
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi, and the Hindi text has no deity_pronoun spans (style guide, section 7). God speaks of himself with "मैं" and is spoken of with the honorific plural. This holds for the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: king; reign: "राजा"; "राज्य करना" (verse 9)
decisions.reason: As the history note settles, the Hebrew melekh is "राजा" and its verb "राज्य करना" ("राजा बनना" for becoming king), so that the LORD's kingship and the human king the people ask for are named with the same words, as in the Hebrew. This holds for the whole book.

decisions.choice: God's "me" is plain "わたし", with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: Japanese has no capitals, so the style guide gives no deity_pronoun span in Japanese; God speaks plain to Samuel.

decisions.choice: "Pakinggan mo ang tinig ng bayan"
decisions.reason: Do what they ask (m1).

decisions.choice: "ako ang kanilang itinakwil upang hindi maging hari sa kanila"
decisions.reason: Yahweh was Israel's king (m2).

decisions.choice: "itinakwil"
decisions.reason: Refused, cast aside (m3).

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun span ("ਮੈਨੂੰ")
decisions.reason: God speaks in the first person.

decisions.choice: king; reign: "ਰਾਜਾ"; "ਰਾਜ ਕਰਨਾ" (verse 9)
decisions.reason: Melek and malak.

source.text: כְּכָֽל־הַמַּעֲשִׂ֣ים אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂ֗וּ מִיּוֹם֩ הַעֲלֹתִ֨י אֹתָ֤ם מִמִּצְרַ֨יִם֙ וְעַד־הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה וַיַּ֣עַזְבֻ֔נִי וַיַּעַבְד֖וּ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים כֵּ֛ן הֵ֥מָּה עֹשִׂ֖ים גַּם־לָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: According to all the deeds which they have done from the day I brought up them from Egypt and until this day, and they have forsaken me and served other gods, so they [are] doing also to you.

en.L: According to all the deeds that they have done from the day I brought them up from Egypt and until this day, and they have forsaken {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and served other gods, so they are doing also to you.
en.B: They are doing to you just what they have always done since the day I brought them up from Egypt: to this very day they have forsaken {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and served other gods.
en.R: Ever since the day I brought them out of Egypt, they have left {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and worshiped other gods. They are still doing it today. Now they are doing the same thing to you.

es.L: Conforme a todas las obras que han hecho desde el día en que los saqué de Egipto hasta el día de hoy, pues {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} han abandonado y han servido a otros dioses, así hacen también contigo.
es.B: Te están haciendo a ti lo mismo que han hecho siempre desde el día en que los saqué de Egipto: hasta el día de hoy {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} han abandonado y han servido a otros dioses.
es.R: Desde el día en que los saqué de Egipto, {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} han dejado y han adorado a otros dioses. Todavía lo siguen haciendo hoy. Ahora te están haciendo lo mismo a ti.

fr.L: Selon toutes les œuvres qu’ils ont faites, depuis le jour où je les ai fait monter d’Égypte et jusqu’à ce jour, et ils {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont abandonné et ont servi d’autres dieux, ainsi font-ils aussi envers toi.
fr.B: Ils agissent envers toi exactement comme ils l’ont toujours fait depuis le jour où je les ai fait monter d’Égypte : jusqu’à ce jour, ils {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont abandonné pour servir d’autres dieux.
fr.R: Depuis le jour où je les ai fait sortir d’Égypte, ils {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont abandonné et ont adoré d’autres dieux. Ils le font encore aujourd’hui. Maintenant, ils font la même chose avec toi.

sw.L: Kulingana na matendo yote waliyoyafanya tangu siku ile nilipowapandisha kutoka Misri mpaka leo, wakaniacha {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} na kutumikia miungu mingine, ndivyo wanavyokutendea na wewe pia.
sw.B: Wanakutendea wewe kama walivyozoea kutenda tangu siku ile nilipowapandisha kutoka Misri: mpaka leo wameniacha na kutumikia miungu mingine.
sw.R: Tangu siku ile nilipowatoa Misri, wameniacha na kuabudu miungu mingine. Bado wanafanya hivyo hata leo. Sasa wanakutendea wewe jambo lile lile.

vi.L: Theo mọi việc họ đã làm từ ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đem họ lên khỏi Ai Cập cho đến ngày nay, họ đã lìa bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và phục vụ các thần khác, thì họ cũng làm như vậy với ngươi.
vi.B: Họ đang đối xử với con đúng như cách họ vẫn làm từ ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đem họ lên khỏi Ai Cập: cho đến tận ngày nay họ vẫn lìa bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và phục vụ các thần khác.
vi.R: Từ ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đem họ ra khỏi Ai Cập, họ đã lìa bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và thờ các thần khác. Đến hôm nay họ vẫn làm như vậy. Bây giờ họ cũng đang làm điều đó với con.

ko.L: 내가 그들을 이집트에서 이끌어 올린 날부터 오늘날까지 그들이 행한 모든 일, 곧 나를 버리고 다른 신들을 섬긴 것처럼, 그들이 너에게도 그렇게 하고 있다.
ko.B: 그들은 내가 그들을 이집트에서 이끌어 낸 날부터 늘 해 오던 대로 너에게도 하고 있다. 오늘날까지 그들은 나를 버리고 다른 신들을 섬겨 왔다.
ko.R: 내가 그들을 이집트에서 데리고 나온 날부터 그들은 나를 버리고 다른 신들을 섬겼다. 오늘날까지도 그렇게 하고 있다. 이제 그들은 너에게도 똑같이 하고 있다.

pt.L: Conforme todas as obras que fizeram desde o dia em que os fiz subir do Egito até este dia, e {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} abandonaram e serviram outros deuses, assim estão fazendo também a ti.
pt.B: Eles estão fazendo contigo exatamente o que sempre fizeram desde o dia em que os tirei do Egito: até hoje {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} abandonaram e serviram outros deuses.
pt.R: Desde o dia em que eu os tirei do Egito, eles {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} abandonaram e adoraram outros deuses. Ainda hoje fazem isso. Agora estão fazendo a mesma coisa contigo.

am.L: ከግብፅ ካወጣኋቸው ቀን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ እንዳደረጉት ሥራ ሁሉ፣ እኔን ትተው ሌሎችን አማልክት እንዳገለገሉ፣ እንዲሁ ደግሞ በአንተ ላይ ያደርጋሉ።
am.B: ከግብፅ ካወጣኋቸው ቀን ጀምሮ ሁልጊዜ ያደርጉት የነበረውን ያንኑ በአንተ ላይ ያደርጋሉ፤ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ እኔን ትተው ሌሎችን አማልክት አገልግለዋል።
am.R: ከግብፅ ካወጣኋቸው ቀን ጀምሮ እኔን ትተው ሌሎችን አማልክት አምልከዋል። ዛሬም ይህንኑ ያደርጋሉ። አሁን ደግሞ በአንተ ላይ ያንኑ ነገር ያደርጋሉ።

hi.L: उन सब कामों के अनुसार जो वे उस दिन से, जब मैं उन्हें मिस्र से निकाल लाया, आज के दिन तक करते आए हैं, कि उन्होंने मुझे त्यागकर दूसरे देवताओं की सेवा की है, वैसा ही वे तुम्हारे साथ भी कर रहे हैं।
hi.B: वे तुम्हारे साथ वही कर रहे हैं जो वे सदा करते आए हैं, उस दिन से जब मैं उन्हें मिस्र से निकाल लाया: आज तक वे मुझे त्यागकर दूसरे देवताओं की सेवा करते आए हैं।
hi.R: जिस दिन से मैं उन्हें मिस्र से निकाल लाया, तब से वे मुझे छोड़कर दूसरे देवताओं की आराधना करते आए हैं। आज भी वे ऐसा ही कर रहे हैं। अब वे तुम्हारे साथ भी वैसा ही कर रहे हैं।

ru.L: По всем делам, которые они делали со дня, когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вывел их из Египта, и до этого дня, — они оставили {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} и служили другим богам, — так они поступают и с тобой.
ru.B: Они поступают с тобой так же, как поступали всегда, со дня, когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вывел их из Египта: по сей день они оставляют {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} и служат другим богам.
ru.R: С того самого дня, когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вывел их из Египта, они оставляли {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} и поклонялись другим богам. Они делают это и сегодня. Теперь они так же поступают и с тобой.

ja.L: 彼らは、わたしが彼らをエジプトから上らせた日から今日この日まで、行ってきたすべての行いのとおり、わたしを捨ててほかの神々に仕えてきた。そのように、彼らはあなたにもしているのである。
ja.B: わたしが彼らをエジプトから導き上った日から今日まで、彼らはいつもわたしを捨て、ほかの神々に仕えてきた。それと同じことを、あなたにもしているのだ。
ja.R: わたしがエジプトから連れ出した日からずっと、彼らはわたしを捨てて、ほかの神々を拝んできた。今日もそうしている。そして今、あなたにも同じことをしているのだ。

uk.L: За всіма вчинками, які вони чинили від дня, коли Я вивів їх з Єгипту, і аж до цього дня, — і покинули {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, і служили іншим богам, — так вони чинять і тобі.
uk.B: Вони чинять тобі те саме, що чинили завжди від дня, коли Я вивів їх з Єгипту: аж до цього дня вони покидали {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}} й служили іншим богам.
uk.R: Від того дня, як Я вивів їх з Єгипту, вони покидали {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}} й поклонялися іншим богам. Вони й сьогодні так роблять. Тепер вони роблять те саме з тобою.

id.L: Sesuai dengan segala perbuatan yang telah mereka lakukan sejak hari {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} membawa mereka keluar dari Mesir sampai hari ini, mereka meninggalkan {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} dan beribadah kepada allah-allah lain; demikian juga mereka lakukan kepadamu.
id.B: Sejak hari {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} membawa mereka keluar dari Mesir sampai hari ini, mereka selalu berbuat begitu: mereka meninggalkan {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} dan beribadah kepada allah-allah lain. Sekarang mereka berbuat yang sama kepadamu.
id.R: Sejak {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} membawa mereka keluar dari Mesir, mereka sudah meninggalkan {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} dan menyembah dewa-dewa lain. Sampai sekarang pun mereka masih melakukannya. Sekarang mereka berbuat hal yang sama kepadamu.

tl.L: Ayon sa lahat ng gawang ginawa nila mula nang araw na iahon ko sila mula sa Egipto at hanggang sa araw na ito, at tinalikuran nila ako at naglingkod sa ibang mga diyos, gayon din ang ginagawa nila sa iyo.
tl.B: Ginagawa nila sa iyo ang palagi nilang ginagawa mula nang araw na iahon ko sila mula sa Egipto: hanggang sa araw na ito ay tinalikuran nila ako at naglingkod sila sa ibang mga diyos.
tl.R: Mula nang araw na ilabas ko sila sa Egipto, iniwan na nila ako at sumamba sa ibang mga diyos. Ginagawa pa rin nila ito hanggang ngayon. Ngayon ay ganito rin ang ginagawa nila sa iyo.

pa.L: ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਸਾਰੇ ਕੰਮਾਂ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਜਿਹੜੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਉਸ ਦਿਨ ਤੋਂ ਕੀਤੇ ਜਦੋਂ ਮੈਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਮਿਸਰ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕੱਢ ਲਿਆਇਆ, ਅਤੇ ਅੱਜ ਦੇ ਦਿਨ ਤੱਕ, ਕਿ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਤਿਆਗ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਹੋਰ ਦੇਵਤਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੀਤੀ, ਉਸੇ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਉਹ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਲ ਵੀ ਕਰ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ।

decisions.choice: from the day I brought them up from Egypt until this day: the whole history of Israel
decisions.reason: Yahweh sums up the story since the exodus as one of repeated unfaithfulness, as the book of Judges tells it (Judges 2:11-13; 10:6-14).

decisions.choice: forsaken me and served other gods: abandoned Yahweh for the worship of other gods

decisions.reason: Balanced puts the main point, what the people are doing to Samuel, first, and then gives the history it is compared with.

decisions.choice: the way of the king: what a king will regularly do and claim as his due
decisions.reason: The word usually means judgment or justice (verse 3), or a ruling or law. But it can also mean the regular practice of a group, as in "the way of the priests" in 2:13, which also describes taking from the people by force. What Samuel goes on to describe (verses 11-17) is not a law that limits the king but what kings will do: take, again and again. So the sense is the king's practice, the demands he will make as if by right. Some take the phrase as "the rights of the king", a formal statement of his powers; Samuel does later write down "the way of the kingdom" in a book (10:25), which may be such a charter. The word also carries irony: Samuel's sons twisted justice, and the king's "justice" will be taking.

decisions.choice: the king who will reign over them: set against the law of the king in Deuteronomy
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 17:14-20 sets limits on Israel's king: he must not gather many horses, many wives, or much silver and gold for himself, and he is to read the law all his life so that he does not raise himself above his fellow Israelites. Samuel's warning describes a king with none of those limits, who takes for himself (verses 11-17).

decisions.choice: only ... surely warn: permission with a solemn condition
decisions.reason: "Only" limits what Yahweh has just allowed. The verb "warn" is doubled for emphasis; it means to warn formally, as a witness who can later be pointed to (Deuteronomy 8:19; 1 Kings 2:42).

decisions.choice: the way of the king (Literal); the ways of the king (Balanced); how the king ... will treat them (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps one word for the one Hebrew noun; Balanced uses the plural, since a list of practices follows; Readable says what the phrase means for the people. The same choice is made in verse 11.

decisions.choice: do as they ask
decisions.reason: As in verse 7, "listen to their voice" means to grant their request.

decisions.choice: "le droit du roi" (Literal); "la manière d’agir du roi" (Balanced)
decisions.reason: The word is what a king will regularly do and claim as his due (m1). French "le droit du roi" keeps the sense of a claim; Balanced says plainly that it is his way of acting, and Readable how he will treat them.

decisions.choice: o direito do rei (L, B); como o rei ... vai tratá-los (R)
decisions.reason: "Direito" keeps the Hebrew word's link with justice (verse 3) and says what Samuel goes on to list: what the king will claim as his due (m1), with the irony of a "right" that takes. One noun at Literal and Balanced, as the English Literal keeps one word; Readable says what it means for the people, as the English does. The same in verse 11.

decisions.choice: "the way (mishpat) of the king": "የንጉሡ ወግ" (L), "የንጉሡ አሠራር" (B), "ንጉሡ ምን እንደሚያደርግባቸው" (R); the same in verse 11.
decisions.reason: It is the king's regular practice and what he will claim as his due, not a law: "ሥርዓት" is kept for statutes and "ፍርድ" would read as a verdict. "ወግ" is custom, "አሠራር" the way someone goes about things.

decisions.choice: the way of the king: "राजा की रीति" (L), "राजा के तौर-तरीक़े" (B); "वह उनके साथ कैसा व्यवहार करेगा" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew mishpat here means what a king will regularly do and claim as his due (m1). Literal says "रीति" (custom), Balanced "तौर-तरीक़े" (ways), and Readable says it with a clause, as the English does. The same in verse 11.

decisions.choice: "обычай царя" (L); "обычаи царя" (B); "как будет обращаться с ними царь" (R)
decisions.reason: Mishpat hammelekh here is what a king will regularly do and claim as his due (m1), not a law that gives him rights. "Обычай" says that, and Readable says it as a clause, as English Readable does. The same wording returns in verse 11.

decisions.choice: mishpat hammelekh "王のならわし" (Literal), "王のやり方" (Balanced), "王が…どのように扱うか" (Readable); the same in verse 11
decisions.reason: The sense is what a king will regularly do and claim as his due; "権利" would make it a lawful right, which the meaning decision leaves open.

decisions.choice: "звичай царя" (L), "права царя" (B), "як поводитиметься цар" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is what a king will claim as his due; "закон" would make it sound like God's law for the king in Deuteronomy.

decisions.choice: "hak raja" (L, B); described at R
decisions.reason: "the way of the king" is what a king will regularly do and claim as his due (m1); "hak" (right, due) says it in one word.

decisions.reason: What a king will regularly do and claim as his due (m1).

decisions.choice: "ang hari na maghahari sa kanila"
decisions.reason: Set against the law of the king in Deuteronomy (m2).

decisions.choice: "Gayunman, taimtim mo silang babalaan"
decisions.reason: Permission with a solemn condition (m3).

decisions.choice: the way of the king: "ਰਾਜੇ ਦੀ ਰੀਤ" (L), "ਤੌਰ-ਤਰੀਕੇ" (B); "ਕਿਹੋ ਜਿਹਾ ਸਲੂਕ ਕਰੇਗਾ" (R)
decisions.reason: Mishpat here is the king's customary practice, his rights as he will claim them.
