es.R: Samuel le contó al pueblo todo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había dicho. Eran ellos los que le pedían un rey.

fr.L: Et Samuel dit toutes les paroles {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} au peuple qui lui demandait un roi.
fr.B: Samuel rapporta donc toutes les paroles {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} au peuple qui lui demandait un roi.
fr.R: Samuel a répété au peuple tout ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait dit. C’étaient eux qui lui demandaient un roi.

sw.L: Na Samweli akawaambia watu waliokuwa wakimwomba mfalme maneno yote ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Basi Samweli akawaeleza watu waliokuwa wakimwomba mfalme yote ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amesema.
sw.R: Samweli akawaeleza watu kila kitu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alichosema. Hao ndio waliokuwa wakimwomba mfalme.

vi.L: Sa-mu-ên nói lại mọi lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho dân đang xin người một vua.
vi.B: Vậy Sa-mu-ên thuật lại mọi lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán cho dân đang xin người một vua.
vi.R: Sa-mu-ên nói lại cho dân chúng mọi điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán. Họ là những người đang xin người lập một vua.

ko.L: 그리고 사무엘이 자기에게 왕을 구하는 백성에게 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 모든 말씀을 전했다.
ko.B: 사무엘은 자기에게 왕을 요구하는 백성에게 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하신 말씀을 모두 전했다.
ko.R: 사무엘은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하신 말씀을 백성에게 모두 전했다. 그들은 사무엘에게 왕을 달라고 요구한 사람들이었다.

pt.L: E Samuel falou todas as palavras {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} ao povo que lhe pedia um rei.
pt.B: Então Samuel contou ao povo que lhe pedia um rei tudo o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha dito.
pt.R: Samuel contou ao povo tudo o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha dito. Eram eles que estavam pedindo um rei a Samuel.

am.L: ሳሙኤልም ከእርሱ ንጉሥ ለሚጠይቁት ሕዝብ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ቃሎች ሁሉ ተናገረ።
am.B: ስለዚህ ሳሙኤል ንጉሥ እንዲሰጣቸው ለጠየቁት ሕዝብ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የተናገረውን ሁሉ ነገራቸው።
am.R: ሳሙኤል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የተናገረውን ሁሉ ለሕዝቡ ነገራቸው። ንጉሥ እንዲሰጣቸው የጠየቁት እነርሱ ነበሩ።

hi.L: और शमूएल ने उन लोगों से, जो उससे राजा माँग रहे थे, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की सब बातें कहीं।
hi.B: तब शमूएल ने उन लोगों को, जो उससे राजा माँग रहे थे, वह सब बताया जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने कहा था।
hi.R: शमूएल ने लोगों को वह सब बताया जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने कहा था। ये वही लोग थे जो उससे राजा माँग रहे थे।

ru.L: И пересказал Самуил все слова {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} народу, просившему у него царя.
ru.B: И Самуил передал народу, просившему у него царя, всё, что сказал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Самуил рассказал народу всё, что сказал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. Это были те люди, которые просили у него царя.

ja.L: そしてサムエルは、彼に王を求めている民に、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のすべての言葉を語った。
ja.B: サムエルは、自分に王を求める民に、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が言われたことをすべて伝えた。
ja.R: サムエルは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が言われたことを、すべて民に話しました。王を求めていたのは、この人々でした。

uk.L: І переказав Самуїл усі слова {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} народові, що просив у нього царя.
uk.B: Тож Самуїл переказав народові, що просив у нього царя, усе, що сказав {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Самуїл переказав народові все, що сказав {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Це вони просили в нього царя.

id.L: Lalu Samuel menyampaikan segala firman {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} kepada rakyat yang meminta seorang raja kepadanya.
id.B: Samuel menyampaikan segala firman {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} kepada rakyat yang meminta seorang raja kepadanya.
id.R: Samuel menyampaikan kepada rakyat semua yang telah difirmankan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}. Merekalah yang meminta seorang raja kepadanya.

tl.L: At sinabi ni Samuel ang lahat ng salita {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}} sa bayan na humihingi sa kaniya ng isang hari.
tl.B: Kaya sinabi ni Samuel sa bayang humihingi sa kaniya ng isang hari ang lahat ng sinabi {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}.
tl.R: Sinabi ni Samuel sa bayan ang lahat ng sinabi {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}. Sila ang humihingi sa kaniya ng isang hari.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਸਮੂਏਲ ਨੇ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਦੀਆਂ ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਗੱਲਾਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਦੱਸੀਆਂ ਜਿਹੜੇ ਉਸ ਤੋਂ ਰਾਜਾ ਮੰਗ ਰਹੇ ਸਨ।
pa.B: ਸੋ ਜਿਹੜੇ ਲੋਕ ਉਸ ਤੋਂ ਰਾਜਾ ਮੰਗ ਰਹੇ ਸਨ, ਸਮੂਏਲ ਨੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਉਹ ਸਭ ਕੁਝ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਜੋ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਨੇ ਕਿਹਾ ਸੀ।
pa.R: ਸਮੂਏਲ ਨੇ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਉਹ ਸਭ ਕੁਝ ਦੱਸ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਜੋ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਨੇ ਕਿਹਾ ਸੀ। ਇਹ ਉਹੀ ਲੋਕ ਸਨ ਜਿਹੜੇ ਉਸ ਤੋਂ ਰਾਜਾ ਮੰਗ ਰਹੇ ਸਨ।

decisions.choice: asking for a king: the verb behind the name Saul
decisions.reason: The verb "ask" is the root of the name Saul, which means "asked for". The people's asking points ahead to the king they will be given (9:2; 12:13, 17).

decisions.choice: all the words of Yahweh: Yahweh's whole answer
decisions.reason: Samuel passes on everything Yahweh said, including that the people have rejected Yahweh as king (verse 7), before giving the warning Yahweh commanded (verse 9).

decisions.choice: They were the ones asking him for a king.
decisions.reason: Readable makes the description of the people a sentence of its own.

decisions.choice: "구하는" (L); "요구하는" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one behind the name Saul (m1); Korean cannot echo the name, so it says the asking plainly, as with Samuel's name in 1:20.

decisions.choice: "माँग रहे थे"
decisions.reason: The verb of asking is the one behind the name Saul (m1) and Hannah's "asked" in chapter 1; Hindi keeps "माँगना" for it, as in 1:17-28, so that the thread can be heard.

decisions.choice: "просившему", "просили"
decisions.reason: The verb is sha'al, behind the name Saul (m1) and Hannah's asking in chapter 1. Russian keeps "просить", the verb used there, so the link stays audible.

decisions.choice: sha'al "求める" at every level
decisions.reason: The verb behind the name Saul; one Japanese verb keeps the echo through chapters 8-12.

decisions.choice: "meminta" for "asking"
decisions.reason: The same verb as Hannah's asking in chapter 1, the verb behind the name Saul (m1).

decisions.choice: "humihingi"
decisions.reason: The verb behind the name Saul (m1).

decisions.choice: "ang lahat ng salita ng PANGINOON"
decisions.reason: Yahweh's whole answer (m2).

decisions.choice: "ਮੰਗ ਰਹੇ ਸਨ"
decisions.reason: Sha'al, asking for; the verb plays on Saul's name in the next chapter.

source.text: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר זֶ֗ה יִֽהְיֶה֙ מִשְׁפַּ֣ט הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִמְלֹ֖ךְ עֲלֵיכֶ֑ם אֶת־בְּנֵיכֶ֣ם יִקָּ֗ח וְשָׂ֥ם לוֹ֙ בְּמֶרְכַּבְתּ֣וֹ וּבְפָרָשָׁ֔יו וְרָצ֖וּ לִפְנֵ֥י מֶרְכַּבְתּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said, This will be [the] way of the king who will reign over you: your sons he will take and appoint for himself in his chariot[s] and among his horsemen, and they will run before his chariot[s],

en.L: And he said, "This will be the way of the king who will reign over you: your sons he will take and set [them] for himself in his chariots and among his horsemen, and they will run before his chariots,
en.B: He said, "These will be the ways of the king who will reign over you: your sons he will take and put to work for himself in his chariots and among his horsemen, and they will run in front of his chariots,
en.R: He said, "This is how the king who rules over you will treat you. He will take your sons and make them serve him. Some will drive his chariots or ride his horses. Others will run in front of his chariots.

es.L: Y dijo: «Este será el proceder del rey que reinará sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}: tomará a {{plural_you:sus hijos|vuestros hijos}} y [los] pondrá para sí en sus carros y entre su gente de a caballo, y correrán delante de sus carros,
es.B: Les dijo: «Así actuará el rey que reinará sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}: tomará a {{plural_you:sus hijos|vuestros hijos}} y los pondrá a su servicio en sus carros y entre su caballería, y correrán delante de sus carros,
es.R: Les dijo: «Así {{plural_you:los|os}} tratará el rey que {{plural_you:los|os}} gobierne. Tomará a {{plural_you:sus hijos|vuestros hijos}} y los hará servirle. Algunos conducirán sus carros de guerra o montarán sus caballos. Otros correrán delante de sus carros.

fr.L: Et il dit : « Voici quel sera le droit du roi qui régnera sur vous : vos fils, il les prendra et les affectera pour lui à ses chars et à ses cavaliers, et ils courront devant ses chars,
fr.B: Il dit : « Voici comment agira le roi qui régnera sur vous : il prendra vos fils et les mettra à son service, pour ses chars et parmi ses cavaliers, et ils courront devant ses chars,
fr.R: Il a dit : « Voici comment vous traitera le roi qui régnera sur vous. Il prendra vos fils et les obligera à le servir. Certains conduiront ses chars ou monteront ses chevaux. D’autres courront devant ses chars.

sw.L: Naye akasema, "Hii itakuwa njia ya mfalme atakayetawala juu yenu: wana wenu atawachukua na kuwaweka kwa ajili yake katika magari yake ya vita na kati ya wapanda farasi wake, nao watakimbia mbele ya magari yake ya vita,
sw.B: Akasema, "Hii ndiyo itakayokuwa mienendo ya mfalme atakayewatawala: atawachukua wana wenu na kuwatumikisha katika magari yake ya vita na kati ya wapanda farasi wake, nao watakimbia mbele ya magari yake ya vita,
sw.R: Akasema, "Hivi ndivyo mfalme atakayewatawala atakavyowatendea. Atawachukua wana wenu wamtumikie. Wengine wataendesha magari yake ya vita au kupanda farasi wake. Wengine watakimbia mbele ya magari yake ya vita.

vi.L: Người nói: "Đây sẽ là đường lối của vua sẽ cai trị trên anh em: Con trai anh em, vua sẽ bắt và đặt [chúng] cho mình trong các chiến xa và giữa các kỵ binh của vua, và chúng sẽ chạy trước các chiến xa của vua,
vi.B: Người nói: "Đây sẽ là cách vua cai trị anh em: Vua sẽ bắt con trai anh em phục dịch mình trong đội chiến xa và đội kỵ binh, và họ sẽ chạy trước chiến xa của vua,
vi.R: Người nói: "Vua cai trị anh em sẽ đối xử với anh em như thế này. Vua sẽ bắt con trai anh em phục dịch mình. Một số sẽ phải đánh xe hoặc cưỡi ngựa cho vua. Số khác sẽ phải chạy trước xe của vua.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 말했다. "너희를 다스릴 왕의 방식은 이러할 것이다. 그가 너희 아들들을 데려다가 자기 병거와 기병대에 두고, 그들이 그의 병거 앞에서 달릴 것이다.
ko.B: 그가 말했다. "너희를 다스릴 왕은 이렇게 할 것이다. 그는 너희 아들들을 데려다가 자기 병거를 몰게 하고 기병으로 삼을 것이며, 그들은 그의 병거 앞에서 달리게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 사무엘이 말했다. "너희를 다스릴 왕은 너희를 이렇게 대할 것이다. 그는 너희 아들들을 데려가서 자기를 섬기게 할 것이다. 어떤 아들들은 그의 병거를 몰거나 그의 말을 탈 것이다. 또 어떤 아들들은 그의 병거 앞에서 달릴 것이다.

pt.L: E disse: "Este será o direito do rei que reinará sobre vocês: os filhos de vocês ele tomará e [os] porá para si nos seus carros e entre os seus cavaleiros, e correrão diante dos seus carros,
pt.B: Ele disse: "Este será o direito do rei que vai reinar sobre vocês: ele tomará os filhos de vocês e os porá a seu serviço nos seus carros de guerra e entre os seus cavaleiros, e eles correrão à frente dos seus carros,
pt.R: Ele disse: "É assim que o rei que reinar sobre vocês vai tratar vocês. Ele vai tomar os filhos de vocês e obrigá-los a servi-lo. Alguns vão dirigir os carros de guerra dele ou montar os seus cavalos. Outros vão correr à frente dos carros dele.

am.L: እንዲህም አለ፦ «በላያችሁ የሚነግሠው የንጉሥ ወግ ይህ ይሆናል፤ ወንዶች ልጆቻችሁን ይወስዳል፤ በሰረገሎቹና በፈረሰኞቹ መካከል ለራሱ ያስቀምጣቸዋል፤ በሰረገሎቹም ፊት ይሮጣሉ፤
am.B: እንዲህም አለ፦ «በላያችሁ የሚነግሠው ንጉሥ አሠራር ይህ ይሆናል፤ ወንዶች ልጆቻችሁን ወስዶ በሰረገሎቹና በፈረሰኞቹ መካከል ለራሱ ያሠራቸዋል፤ በሰረገሎቹም ፊት ይሮጣሉ፤
am.R: እንዲህም አለ፦ «የሚገዛችሁ ንጉሥ የሚያደርግባችሁ ይህ ነው። ወንዶች ልጆቻችሁን ወስዶ እንዲያገለግሉት ያደርጋል። አንዳንዶቹ ሰረገሎቹን ይነዳሉ፤ ወይም ፈረሶቹን ይጋልባሉ። ሌሎቹ ደግሞ በሰረገሎቹ ፊት ይሮጣሉ።

hi.L: और उसने कहा, "जो राजा तुम पर राज्य करेगा, उसकी रीति यह होगी: वह तुम्हारे पुत्रों को लेकर अपने रथों में और अपने घुड़सवारों में रखेगा, और वे उसके रथों के आगे-आगे दौड़ेंगे,
hi.B: उसने कहा, "जो राजा तुम पर राज्य करेगा, उसके तौर-तरीक़े ये होंगे: वह तुम्हारे पुत्रों को लेकर अपने रथों और घुड़सवारों के काम में लगाएगा, और वे उसके रथों के आगे-आगे दौड़ेंगे,
hi.R: उसने कहा, "जो राजा तुम पर राज्य करेगा, वह तुम्हारे साथ ऐसा व्यवहार करेगा। वह तुम्हारे बेटों को लेकर अपनी सेवा में लगाएगा। कुछ उसके रथ चलाएँगे या उसके घोड़ों पर सवार होंगे। दूसरे उसके रथों के आगे-आगे दौड़ेंगे।

ru.L: И сказал он: «Вот каков будет обычай царя, который будет царствовать над вами: ваших сыновей он возьмёт и поставит их себе к своим колесницам и в свои всадники, и они будут бегать перед его колесницами,
ru.B: Он сказал: «Вот каковы будут обычаи царя, который будет царствовать над вами: ваших сыновей он возьмёт и заставит служить себе при своих колесницах и среди своих всадников, и они будут бежать впереди его колесниц,
ru.R: Он сказал: «Вот как будет обращаться с вами царь, который будет вами править. Он возьмёт ваших сыновей и заставит их служить себе. Одни будут править его колесницами или ездить на его конях. Другие будут бегать впереди его колесниц.

decisions.choice: the way of the king: as in verse 9
decisions.reason: What follows is the king's practice, the demands he will make as if by right. See verse 9.

decisions.choice: he will take: the key word of Samuel's speech
decisions.reason: The verb "take" comes again and again (verses 11, 13, 14, 16), and "take a tenth" twice more (verses 15, 17). The king the people want is above all one who takes. The list moves from their sons and daughters to their land, their harvest, their servants and animals, and at last to the people themselves (verse 17).

decisions.choice: chariots, horsemen and runners: a standing royal army and guard
decisions.reason: Chariots and horses were the costly core of a king's army, the very thing Deuteronomy 17:16 tells Israel's king not to multiply. Men running ahead of a king's chariot were a sign of royal rank (2 Samuel 15:1; 1 Kings 1:5). The word for chariot is singular in Hebrew but stands for the king's whole chariot force.

decisions.choice: put to work for himself
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says the king will "set them for himself" in his chariots. Balanced makes clear that this is service the king requires of them.

decisions.choice: Some will drive his chariots or ride his horses.
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the long Hebrew sentence into short ones and says what the sons will do with the chariots and horses.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:sus hijos|vuestros hijos}} and the like through Samuel's speech (verses 11-18)
decisions.reason: Samuel speaks to the whole people, so every "your" and "you" is plural and takes the plural-you setting. With the ustedes default, "sus hijos" could also mean the king's sons; the span keeps the possessor clear as the people.

decisions.choice: atawachukua
decisions.reason: Samuel's speech turns on "he will take" (m2); Swahili keeps one verb, "kuchukua", through verses 11-17 at every level so the repetition can be heard.

decisions.choice: "bắt" for "he will take", repeated through verses 11-17
decisions.reason: The key word of Samuel's speech (meaning decision); "bắt" says taking people by force, and the Vietnamese keeps one verb for people and "lấy" for property, so the repetition is still heard.

decisions.choice: Each verse of the list (verses 11-12) is closed as its own Korean sentence
alternatives: one Korean sentence across the two verse markers, as the English Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: A Korean sentence ends with its verb, so the list that runs on from verse 11 into verse 12 is cut at the verse marker and verse 12 starts with its own subject.

decisions.choice: o direito do rei; tomará (every time); os filhos de vocês
decisions.reason: Samuel addresses the people with "vocês". "Os filhos de vocês" is used where "os seus filhos" could mean the king's sons. "Tomar" is kept for each "take" of the speech (m2), so the repetition is heard.

decisions.choice: Samuel speaks to the people in the plain style at every level, Readable too (あなたたち)
decisions.reason: A prophet's warning to the assembly, as Moses' speeches in Deuteronomy.

decisions.choice: "kereta perang", "pasukan berkuda"
decisions.reason: The glossary words for chariots and horsemen; "dia akan mengambil" (he will take) is kept as the speech's refrain (m2).

decisions.choice: "ang paraan ng hari"
decisions.reason: As in verse 9 (m1).

decisions.choice: "kukunin niya"
decisions.reason: The key word of Samuel's speech (m2).

decisions.choice: "mga karwahe ... mga mangangabayo ... tatakbo sila sa unahan"
decisions.reason: A standing royal army and guard (m3).

records.literal_gloss: and to appoint for himself commanders of thousands and commanders of fifties, and to plow his plowing and to reap his harvest, and to make weapons of his war and [the] equipment of his chariot[s].

en.L: and to set for himself commanders of thousands and commanders of fifties, and to plow his plowing and to reap his harvest, and to make his weapons of war and the equipment of his chariots.
en.B: and he will appoint some for himself as commanders of thousands and commanders of fifties, and others to plow his fields and reap his harvest and make his weapons of war and the equipment for his chariots.

uk.R: Одних він зробить військовими начальниками над тисячею чи над пʼятдесятьма воїнами. Інших він примусить орати його поля й збирати його врожай. Ще інші мусять робити зброю для його війська й частини для його колісниць.

id.L: dan [dia akan] mengangkat bagi dirinya kepala-kepala pasukan seribu dan kepala-kepala pasukan lima puluh, dan [menyuruh mereka] membajak ladangnya dan menuai panennya, dan membuat senjata-senjata perangnya dan perlengkapan kereta-kereta perangnya.

tl.L: at maglalagay para sa kaniyang sarili ng mga pinuno ng libu-libo at mga pinuno ng lima-limampu, at upang mag-araro ng kaniyang aararuhin at umani ng kaniyang aanihin, at gumawa ng kaniyang mga sandata sa digmaan at ng mga kagamitan ng kaniyang mga karwahe.
tl.B: at hihirangin niya ang ilan bilang mga pinuno ng libu-libo at mga pinuno ng lima-limampu, at ang iba ay mag-aararo ng kaniyang mga bukid at aani ng kaniyang ani at gagawa ng kaniyang mga sandata sa digmaan at ng mga kagamitan ng kaniyang mga karwahe.
tl.R: Gagawin niyang mga opisyal sa hukbo ang ilan sa kanila, na mamamahala sa sanlibo o limampung lalaki. Ang iba ay pag-aararuhin niya sa kaniyang mga bukid at pag-aanihin. Ang iba pa ay kailangang gumawa ng mga sandata para sa kaniyang hukbo at ng mga piyesa para sa kaniyang mga karwahe.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਲਈ ਹਜ਼ਾਰਾਂ ਦੇ ਸਰਦਾਰ ਅਤੇ ਪੰਜਾਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਸਰਦਾਰ ਠਹਿਰਾਉਣ ਲਈ, ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਵਾਹੀ ਵਾਹੁਣ ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਫ਼ਸਲ ਵੱਢਣ ਲਈ, ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਯੁੱਧ ਦੇ ਹਥਿਆਰ ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਰਥਾਂ ਦਾ ਸਾਮਾਨ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਲਈ।
pa.B: ਅਤੇ ਕੁਝ ਨੂੰ ਉਹ ਆਪਣੇ ਲਈ ਹਜ਼ਾਰਾਂ ਉੱਤੇ ਅਤੇ ਪੰਜਾਹਾਂ ਉੱਤੇ ਸਰਦਾਰ ਥਾਪੇਗਾ, ਅਤੇ ਹੋਰਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਖੇਤ ਵਾਹੁਣ, ਆਪਣੀ ਫ਼ਸਲ ਵੱਢਣ, ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਜੰਗੀ ਹਥਿਆਰ ਅਤੇ ਰਥਾਂ ਦਾ ਸਾਮਾਨ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਉੱਤੇ ਲਾਵੇਗਾ।
pa.R: ਉਹ ਕੁਝ ਨੂੰ ਫ਼ੌਜ ਦੇ ਅਫ਼ਸਰ ਬਣਾਵੇਗਾ, ਜਿਹੜੇ ਹਜ਼ਾਰ ਜਾਂ ਪੰਜਾਹ ਆਦਮੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਮੁਖੀ ਹੋਣਗੇ। ਹੋਰਨਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਉਹ ਆਪਣੇ ਖੇਤ ਵਹਾਏਗਾ ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਫ਼ਸਲ ਕਟਵਾਏਗਾ। ਹੋਰਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਫ਼ੌਜ ਲਈ ਹਥਿਆਰ ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਰਥਾਂ ਦੇ ਪੁਰਜ਼ੇ ਬਣਾਉਣੇ ਪੈਣਗੇ।

decisions.choice: commanders of thousands and commanders of fifties: officers over army units
decisions.reason: The army was organized in units under their commanders (Exodus 18:21; Numbers 31:14; 2 Kings 1:9). "Thousand" may name a unit raised from a clan rather than an exact count (see the note at Numbers 1:21). Saul later asks whether David would make his men "commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds" (22:7).

decisions.choice: plow his plowing and reap his harvest: forced labor on the king's land
decisions.reason: The king will own estates of his own and make free Israelites work them. Solomon later raised forced labor from all Israel (1 Kings 5:27; 12:4).

decisions.choice: weapons of war and the equipment of his chariots: arms and gear made in the king's workshops
decisions.reason: The first phrase names weapons in general; the second the fittings and gear of chariots. The king's war machine will be built by the labor of Israel's sons.

decisions.choice: some ... others
decisions.reason: The Hebrew lists the tasks one after another. Balanced supplies "some" and "others" to show that the sons will be divided among them.

decisions.choice: army officers, in charge of a thousand men or fifty men
decisions.reason: Readable explains the titles. Like the other levels it keeps the numbers of the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "тисячники й пʼятидесятники" for the commanders of thousands and of fifties
decisions.reason: The words of the old army ranks; Readable says what they were, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "mga pinuno ng libu-libo at mga pinuno ng lima-limampu"
decisions.reason: Officers over army units (m1).

decisions.choice: "mag-araro ng kaniyang aararuhin at umani ng kaniyang aanihin"
decisions.reason: Forced labor on the king's land (m2).

decisions.choice: "mga sandata sa digmaan at ng mga kagamitan ng kaniyang mga karwahe"
decisions.reason: Arms and gear made in the king's workshops (m3).

decisions.choice: perfumers and cooks: women who mixed perfumes and prepared food
decisions.reason: The first word is from the verb for mixing spices and oils, used for making the holy anointing oil and incense (Exodus 30:25, 35). The second can mean cooks or those who slaughter and prepare meat; the related word for a man is used of the cook in 9:23-24.

decisions.choice: your daughters he will take: service in the royal household
decisions.reason: A king's palace needed many workers. Daughters would be taken from their families to serve the court, as sons were taken to serve the army (verses 11-12).

decisions.choice: to make perfumes for him, and to cook and bake for him
decisions.reason: Readable turns the names of the tasks into verbs and adds "for him", for whom the work is done.

decisions.choice: "mga manggagawa ng pabango at mga tagapagluto"
decisions.reason: Women who mixed perfumes and prepared food (m1).

decisions.choice: "ang inyong mga anak na babae ay kukunin niya"
decisions.reason: Service in the royal household (m2).

decisions.choice: your fields ... he will take: the family land Yahweh gave
decisions.reason: Each family's land was its inheritance from Yahweh and was not to pass out of the family for good (Leviticus 25:23; Numbers 36:7). A king who takes land breaks that order, as Ahab later did with Naboth's vineyard (1 Kings 21:1-16).

decisions.choice: his servants: the king's courtiers and officers
decisions.reason: Here the word names the men who serve the king at court and in his army. Saul later reminds his men that he is the one who can give them fields and vineyards (22:7).

decisions.choice: officials
decisions.reason: The word Literal renders "servants" here means the king's court officials, so Balanced and Readable say "officials", as the term list for these books sets out.

decisions.choice: "ses serviteurs" (Literal); "ses officiers" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note settles for the king's servants: the courtiers and officers of the king (m2).

decisions.choice: "sus siervos" (L); "sus oficiales" (B, R)
decisions.reason: For 1 and 2 Samuel, as the Samuel terms note: the king's servants who are his court officials (m2) are "siervos" at Literal and "oficiales" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: watumishi wake (L); maafisa wake (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note: the king's servants are "watumishi wa mfalme" at Literal and "maafisa wa mfalme" at Balanced and Readable, since they are his courtiers and officers (m2).

decisions.choice: "các đầy tớ của vua" (L); "các quần thần" (B); "các quan chức" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note for the king's servants: Literal keeps "servants", Balanced the court word, Readable the plain "officials".

decisions.choice: "신하들"
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note for the king's servants; "신하" is a king's official, so one word serves every level.

decisions.choice: the king's servants: "दास" (L); "अधिकारी" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch note keeps eved as "दास" at every level, with a decision where another sense is the point. Here the king's servants are his courtiers and officers (m2), so Balanced and Readable say "अधिकारी", as the English says "officials"; Literal keeps "दास". In verse 15 the eunuchs are "खोजे" (L) and "दरबारी" (B, R).

decisions.choice: "рабы" (L); "приближённые" (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole of 1 Samuel, the king's 'avadim are his courtiers and officers (m2). Literal keeps "раб", as the Pentateuch note settles for 'eved; Balanced and Readable say what they were, as English Balanced and Readable say "officials". The household slaves of verse 16 stay "рабы" at every level.

decisions.choice: avadav (the king's servants) "家臣" (Literal, Balanced), "家来" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Genesis convention for courtiers; these are the king's officers, not household slaves.

decisions.choice: "раби" (L), "придворні" (B, R) for the king's servants, for the whole book
decisions.reason: The shared Samuel note: Literal keeps the slave word, Balanced and Readable name the king's officials.

decisions.choice: "pegawai" for "his servants"
decisions.reason: The glossary's word for the king's officials (m2), at every level.

decisions.choice: "ang inyong mga bukid ... ay kukunin niya"
decisions.reason: The family land Yahweh gave (m1).

decisions.choice: "kaniyang mga lingkod"
decisions.reason: The king's courtiers and officers (m2).

decisions.choice: the king's servants: "ਦਾਸ" (L); "ਅਧਿਕਾਰੀ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Royal servants were officials of the court.

decisions.choice: he will tithe: the king takes a tenth as if it were his own
decisions.reason: The tenth of the land's produce belonged to Yahweh and was given to the Levites, or eaten before Yahweh with the poor (Leviticus 27:30-32; Numbers 18:21; Deuteronomy 14:22-29). The king will claim a tenth for himself.

decisions.choice: eunuchs: royal officials, perhaps castrated men
decisions.reason: The word can mean a man who has been castrated, as palace servants often were in the ancient Near East, or more broadly a high court official. Potiphar, who had a wife, is called by this word (Genesis 37:36; 39:1). Here it most likely names the king's officers in general.

decisions.choice: your seeds: the grain grown from your sowing
decisions.reason: The plural of "seed" here means the crops of the fields, set beside the produce of the vineyards.

decisions.choice: grain; grape harvest (Balanced); court officials and servants
decisions.reason: Literal says "grain" for "seeds" and keeps "vineyards"; Balanced and Readable name what is taken from the vineyards, the grapes. Balanced says "court officials" for the first word and keeps "servants" for the second, so that the two groups stay distinct.

decisions.choice: matowashi (L); maafisa wa ikulu (B); maafisa (R)
decisions.reason: "Towashi" is the Swahili word for a eunuch; Literal keeps it, while Balanced and Readable say officials, as the English does, since the word may simply mean a royal official (m2).

decisions.choice: "hoạn quan" (L); "triều thần" (B); "quan chức" (R) for *sarisim*
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note: Literal keeps "eunuchs", with the meaning decision's doubt; Balanced and Readable say court officials.

decisions.choice: "내시들" (L); "궁정 관리들" (B); "관리들" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note: Literal keeps the word's first sense, and Balanced and Readable say "officials", which is what it often means.

decisions.choice: eunuchs (saris) are "ጃንደረቦች" at Literal; "የቤተ መንግሥቱ ባለ ሥልጣናት" (B), "ባለ ሥልጣናቱ" (R).
decisions.reason: As the English: the word names royal officials; "ጃንደረባ" is the word Acts 8:27 uses.

decisions.choice: "евнухи" (L); "вельможи" (B); "придворные" (R)
decisions.reason: Sarisim were royal officials, some perhaps castrated (m2). Literal keeps the old word; Balanced and Readable name them as officials, as the samuel terms note does in English.

decisions.choice: saris "宦官" (Literal), "宮廷の役人" (Balanced), "役人" (Readable)
decisions.reason: As the English levels: Literal keeps the word, Balanced and Readable give the office, since the meaning decision leaves castration uncertain.

decisions.choice: "євнухи" (L), "царедворці" (B), "урядовці" (R)
decisions.reason: The shared Samuel note: the word may mean a court official; Balanced and Readable give that sense.

decisions.choice: "sida-sida" (L); "pegawai istana" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The glossary forms for eunuchs, royal officials who may or may not have been castrated (m2).

decisions.choice: "kukunan niya ng ikasampung bahagi"
decisions.reason: The king takes a tenth as if it were his own (m1).

decisions.choice: "mga eunuko"
decisions.reason: Royal officials, perhaps castrated men (m2).

decisions.choice: "mga butil"
decisions.reason: The grain grown from your sowing (m3).

es.R: Tomará a {{plural_you:sus siervos|vuestros siervos}}, hombres y mujeres, y a {{plural_you:sus jóvenes|vuestros jóvenes}} más fuertes y {{plural_you:sus burros|vuestros burros}}. A todos los hará trabajar para él.

fr.L: Et vos esclaves et vos servantes, et vos jeunes gens, les meilleurs, et vos ânes, il les prendra et les emploiera à son ouvrage.
fr.B: Il prendra vos serviteurs et vos servantes, l’élite de vos jeunes gens, ainsi que vos ânes, et il les fera travailler pour lui.
fr.R: Il prendra vos serviteurs, hommes et femmes, vos jeunes gens les plus forts et vos ânes. Il les obligera tous à travailler pour lui.

sw.L: Na watumwa wenu wa kiume na watumwa wenu wa kike, na vijana wenu, walio bora, na punda wenu atawachukua na kuwatumikisha katika kazi yake.
sw.B: Atawachukua watumishi wenu wa kiume na wa kike, vijana wenu walio bora, na punda wenu, na kuwatumikisha kwa kazi zake.
sw.R: Atawachukua watumishi wenu, wanaume kwa wanawake, na vijana wenu wenye nguvu kuliko wote, na punda wenu. Atawafanya wote wamfanyie kazi.

vi.L: Tôi trai, tớ gái của anh em, và những thanh niên tốt nhất của anh em, cùng lừa của anh em, vua sẽ bắt và dùng [chúng] vào công việc của vua.
vi.B: Vua sẽ bắt tôi trai tớ gái của anh em, những thanh niên tốt nhất và lừa của anh em, để làm việc cho vua.
vi.R: Vua sẽ bắt đầy tớ nam nữ của anh em, những thanh niên khỏe mạnh nhất và lừa của anh em. Vua sẽ bắt tất cả phải làm việc cho vua.

ko.L: 그리고 너희 남종과 여종과 너희 젊은이들 가운데 가장 좋은 자들과 너희 나귀들을 빼앗아 자기 일에 부릴 것이다.
ko.B: 그는 너희의 남종과 여종과 가장 뛰어난 젊은이들과 나귀들을 빼앗아 자기 일을 시킬 것이다.
ko.R: 그는 너희의 남종과 여종, 가장 힘센 젊은이들과 너희 나귀들을 데려갈 것이다. 그리고 그들을 모두 자기를 위해 일하게 할 것이다.

pt.L: E os seus escravos, e as suas escravas, e os seus jovens, os melhores, e os seus jumentos ele tomará e [os] porá no seu trabalho.
pt.B: Ele tomará os servos e as servas de vocês, os melhores dos seus jovens e os seus jumentos, e os porá para trabalhar para ele.
pt.R: Ele vai tomar os servos e as servas de vocês, os rapazes mais fortes e os jumentos. Vai fazer todos eles trabalharem para ele.

am.L: ወንዶች ባሪያዎቻችሁንና ሴቶች ባሪያዎቻችሁን፣ መልካም መልካሞቹንም ጎበዛዝታችሁን፣ አህዮቻችሁንም ይወስዳል፤ ለሥራውም ያሠራቸዋል።
am.B: ወንዶችና ሴቶች አገልጋዮቻችሁን፣ ከጎበዛዝታችሁ የተሻሉትንና አህዮቻችሁን ወስዶ ለራሱ ሥራ ያሠራቸዋል።
am.R: ወንዶችና ሴቶች አገልጋዮቻችሁን፣ ብርቱ ጎበዛዝታችሁንና አህዮቻችሁን ይወስዳል። ሁሉንም ለራሱ ያሠራቸዋል።

hi.L: और वह तुम्हारे दासों और तुम्हारी दासियों, और तुम्हारे जवानों में से जो अच्छे [हैं], और तुम्हारे गधों को लेकर अपने काम में लगाएगा।
hi.B: वह तुम्हारे दास-दासियों को, तुम्हारे सबसे अच्छे जवानों को और तुम्हारे गधों को लेकर अपने काम में लगाएगा।
hi.R: वह तुम्हारे दासों और दासियों को, तुम्हारे सबसे तगड़े जवानों को और तुम्हारे गधों को ले लेगा। वह उन सबसे अपना काम करवाएगा।

ru.L: И ваших рабов, и ваших рабынь, и ваших юношей, лучших, и ваших ослов он возьмёт и употребит [их] для своей работы.
ru.B: Он заберёт ваших рабов и рабынь, лучших из ваших юношей и ваших ослов и заставит их работать на себя.
ru.R: Он заберёт ваших рабов и рабынь, ваших самых сильных юношей и ваших ослов. Он заставит их всех работать на него.

ja.L: また、あなたがたの男奴隷と女奴隷、あなたがたの若者たちの良い者、そしてあなたがたのろばを取って、自分の仕事に使う。
ja.B: あなたがたの男女の召し使い、若者の中の優れた者、またろばを取り上げて、自分のために働かせる。
ja.R: あなたたちの召し使いを、男も女も連れて行く。いちばん強い若者や、ろばも取り上げる。そして、みな王のために働かせる。

uk.L: І ваших рабів, і ваших рабинь, і ваших юнаків, найкращих, і ваших ослів візьме і пристосує [їх] до своєї праці.
uk.B: Він забере ваших рабів і рабинь, найкращих ваших юнаків і ваших ослів і примусить їх працювати на себе.
uk.R: Він забере ваших слуг і служниць, найсильніших юнаків і ваших ослів. Він змусить їх усіх працювати на нього.

id.L: Dan budak-budak laki-laki kalian dan budak-budak perempuan kalian, dan pemuda-pemuda kalian yang terbaik, dan keledai-keledai kalian akan diambilnya dan dipekerjakannya untuk pekerjaannya.
id.B: Budak-budak laki-laki dan perempuan kalian, pemuda-pemuda kalian yang terbaik, dan keledai-keledai kalian akan diambilnya dan dipekerjakannya untuk kepentingannya.
id.R: Dia akan mengambil hamba-hamba kalian, laki-laki dan perempuan, pemuda-pemuda kalian yang paling kuat, dan keledai-keledai kalian. Dia akan menyuruh mereka semua bekerja untuk dia.

tl.L: At ang inyong mga aliping lalaki at ang inyong mga aliping babae, at ang inyong mga binata, ang mga pinakamabuti, at ang inyong mga asno ay kukunin niya at ilalagay [sila] sa kaniyang gawain.
tl.B: Kukunin niya ang inyong mga aliping lalaki at babae, ang pinakamabuti sa inyong mga binata, at ang inyong mga asno, at pagtatrabahuhin niya sila para sa kaniya.
tl.R: Kukunin niya ang inyong mga alipin, lalaki man o babae, at ang pinakamalalakas ninyong binata at ang inyong mga asno. Pagtatrabahuhin niya silang lahat para sa kaniya.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਦਾਸ ਅਤੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੀਆਂ ਦਾਸੀਆਂ, ਅਤੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਗੱਭਰੂ, ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਚੰਗੇ [ਚੰਗੇ], ਅਤੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਗਧੇ ਉਹ ਲੈ ਕੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਕੰਮ ਉੱਤੇ ਲਾਵੇਗਾ।
pa.B: ਉਹ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਨੌਕਰ ਅਤੇ ਨੌਕਰਾਣੀਆਂ, ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵਧੀਆ ਜਵਾਨ, ਅਤੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਗਧੇ ਲੈ ਲਵੇਗਾ ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਆਪਣਾ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਵਾਏਗਾ।
pa.R: ਉਹ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਨੌਕਰ, ਆਦਮੀ ਵੀ ਅਤੇ ਔਰਤਾਂ ਵੀ, ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਤਕੜੇ ਜਵਾਨ ਅਤੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਗਧੇ ਲੈ ਲਵੇਗਾ। ਉਹ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਸਾਰਿਆਂ ਤੋਂ ਆਪਣੇ ਲਈ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਵਾਏਗਾ।

decisions.choice: your young men (the Hebrew text)
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation reads "your cattle", which in Hebrew differs by one letter and would fit beside "your donkeys". The Hebrew text, "your young men", is kept; it also makes sense in a list of workers, and the meaning of the verse is the same: the king takes labor.

decisions.choice: your male slaves and female slaves: the workers of a household
decisions.reason: Many Israelite households had slaves, owned rather than hired (Exodus 21:2-11). The king will take even them for his own service.

decisions.choice: his work: the king's projects and labor
decisions.reason: The word means work or labor of any kind. It will be used of the king's building works and their forced labor (1 Kings 5:30; 9:23).

decisions.choice: male and female servants
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "slaves"; Balanced and Readable say "servants", as the style guide sets out, since the point here is their work, not their slavery.

decisions.choice: "男奴隷と女奴隷" (Literal), "男女の召し使い" (Balanced), "召し使い…男も女も" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Deuteronomy forms for household slaves, following the English levels.

decisions.choice: "budak" (L, B); "hamba" (R)
decisions.reason: Slavery is the point of Samuel's warning (m2), so Balanced keeps "budak" as the glossary allows; Readable says "hamba", as its English says "servants".

decisions.choice: "ang inyong mga binata"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text (m1).

decisions.choice: "mga aliping lalaki at ... mga aliping babae"
decisions.reason: The workers of a household (m2).

decisions.choice: "kaniyang gawain"
decisions.reason: The king's projects and labor (m3).

records.literal_gloss: Your flock he will tithe, and you, you will be to him for slaves.

en.L: Your flocks he will tithe, and you yourselves will become his slaves.
en.B: Of your flocks he will take a tenth, and you yourselves will become his slaves.
en.R: He will take one out of every ten of your sheep and goats. And you yourselves will become his slaves.

es.L: {{plural_you:Sus rebaños|Vuestros rebaños}} diezmará, y {{plural_you:ustedes mismos serán|vosotros mismos seréis}} sus esclavos.
es.B: De {{plural_you:sus rebaños|vuestros rebaños}} se quedará con la décima parte, y {{plural_you:ustedes mismos llegarán|vosotros mismos llegaréis}} a ser sus esclavos.
es.R: Se quedará con una de cada diez de {{plural_you:sus ovejas y cabras|vuestras ovejas y cabras}}. Y {{plural_you:ustedes mismos serán|vosotros mismos seréis}} sus esclavos.

fr.L: Votre petit bétail, il en prélèvera la dîme, et vous, vous deviendrez ses esclaves.
fr.B: Il prélèvera le dixième de vos troupeaux, et vous-mêmes, vous deviendrez ses esclaves.
fr.R: Il prendra un mouton ou une chèvre sur dix. Et vous-mêmes, vous deviendrez ses esclaves.

sw.L: Kondoo na mbuzi wenu atawatoza sehemu ya kumi, nanyi wenyewe mtakuwa watumwa wake.
sw.B: Atachukua sehemu ya kumi ya kondoo na mbuzi wenu, nanyi wenyewe mtakuwa watumwa wake.
sw.R: Atachukua mmoja kati ya kila kondoo na mbuzi kumi mlio nao. Nanyi wenyewe mtakuwa watumwa wake.

vi.L: Bầy chiên dê của anh em, vua sẽ thu một phần mười, còn chính anh em sẽ làm nô lệ cho vua.
vi.B: Vua sẽ thu một phần mười bầy chiên dê của anh em, và chính anh em sẽ trở thành nô lệ của vua.
vi.R: Cứ mười con chiên con dê của anh em thì vua lấy một. Và chính anh em sẽ trở thành nô lệ của vua.

ko.L: 그가 너희 양 떼의 십분의 일을 거둘 것이고, 너희 자신은 그의 종이 될 것이다.
ko.B: 그는 너희 양 떼의 십분의 일을 거두어 갈 것이고, 너희 자신은 그의 종이 될 것이다.
ko.R: 그는 너희 양과 염소를 열 마리에 한 마리씩 가져갈 것이다. 그리고 너희 자신은 그의 노예가 될 것이다.

pt.L: Dos seus rebanhos ele tomará o dízimo, e vocês mesmos serão escravos dele.
pt.B: Dos rebanhos de vocês ele tomará a décima parte, e vocês mesmos se tornarão escravos dele.
pt.R: Ele vai tomar uma de cada dez das ovelhas e cabras de vocês. E vocês mesmos vão se tornar escravos dele.

am.L: ከመንጋችሁ አሥራት ይወስዳል፤ እናንተም ራሳችሁ ባሪያዎቹ ትሆናላችሁ።
am.B: ከመንጋችሁ አንድ አሥረኛውን ይወስዳል፤ እናንተም ራሳችሁ ባሪያዎቹ ትሆናላችሁ።

hi.L: वह तुम्हारी भेड़-बकरियों का दसवाँ अंश लेगा, और तुम स्वयं उसके दास बन जाओगे।

ru.L: С вашего мелкого скота он будет брать десятину, а вы сами будете ему рабами.
ru.B: С ваших стад он будет брать десятую часть, а вы сами станете его рабами.
ru.R: Он будет забирать каждую десятую овцу и козу из ваших стад. А вы сами станете его рабами.

ja.L: あなたがたの羊の群れの十分の一を取り、あなたがた自身は彼の奴隷となる。
ja.B: 羊ややぎの群れの十分の一を取り、あなたがた自身も王の奴隷となる。
ja.R: 羊とやぎの十匹に一匹を取り上げる。そして、あなたたち自身も、王の奴隷になってしまう。

uk.L: З вашої отари візьме десятину, а ви самі станете йому рабами.
uk.B: З ваших отар він братиме десятину, а ви самі станете його рабами.
uk.R: Він забиратиме кожну десяту вівцю чи козу з вашої отари. А ви самі станете його рабами.

id.L: Dari kambing domba kalian akan diambilnya sepersepuluh, dan kalian sendiri akan menjadi budaknya.
id.B: Dari kambing domba kalian dia akan mengambil sepersepuluh, dan kalian sendiri akan menjadi budaknya.
id.R: Dia akan mengambil satu dari setiap sepuluh ekor domba dan kambing kalian. Dan kalian sendiri akan menjadi budaknya.

tl.L: Ang inyong mga kawan ay kukunan niya ng ikasampung bahagi, at kayo mismo ay magiging kaniyang mga alipin.
tl.B: Kukunin niya ang ikasampung bahagi ng inyong mga kawan, at kayo mismo ay magiging kaniyang mga alipin.
tl.R: Kukunin niya ang isa sa bawat sampu ng inyong mga tupa at kambing. At kayo mismo ay magiging kaniyang mga alipin.

pa.L: ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਇੱਜੜਾਂ ਦਾ ਉਹ ਦਸਵੰਧ ਲਵੇਗਾ, ਅਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆਪ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਦਾਸ ਬਣ ਜਾਓਗੇ।
pa.B: ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਇੱਜੜਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਉਹ ਦਸਵਾਂ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਲਵੇਗਾ, ਅਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਦਾਸ ਬਣ ਜਾਓਗੇ।
pa.R: ਤੁਹਾਡੀਆਂ ਭੇਡਾਂ ਬੱਕਰੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਉਹ ਹਰ ਦਸਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਇੱਕ ਲੈ ਲਵੇਗਾ। ਅਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆਪ ਵੀ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਦਾਸ ਬਣ ਜਾਓਗੇ।

decisions.choice: you will become his slaves: back to what Yahweh freed them from
decisions.reason: Yahweh brought Israel out of "the house of slaves" (Exodus 20:2) and said that the Israelites are his own slaves and must not be sold as slaves (Leviticus 25:42). Samuel's list ends where it has been heading: not only their goods but the people themselves will belong to the king.

decisions.choice: you yourselves: the pronoun is stressed
decisions.reason: The pronoun "you" is written out in addition to the verb, setting the people themselves against the flocks and fields just listed.

decisions.choice: flock: sheep and goats
decisions.reason: The word covers both sheep and goats kept together in one flock.

decisions.choice: slaves
decisions.reason: Here slavery itself is the point: the warning recalls Israel's slavery in Egypt. So every level keeps "slaves", as the style guide asks where "servant" would change the meaning.

decisions.choice: "esclaves" at every level
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch note keeps "esclave" at every level where slavery itself is the point; Samuel warns that the people will go back to what the LORD freed them from in Egypt (m1).

decisions.choice: watumwa
decisions.reason: Here the point is slavery itself, a return to what the LORD freed them from (m1), so every level says "watumwa", as the English says "slaves".
The Korean notes keep "종" for *ʿeved* and "노예" where slavery itself is meant; here it is the loss of freedom Yahweh once ended (m1), which Readable says plainly.

decisions.choice: "उसके दास" at every level
decisions.reason: The people who were freed from slavery in Egypt will become slaves again (m1), so the word stays "दास" at every level, as the English keeps "slaves".

decisions.choice: "奴隷" at every level
decisions.reason: Slavery itself is the point (back to what God freed them from), so the English keeps "slaves" at every level and so does the Japanese.

decisions.choice: "kayo ... ay magiging kaniyang mga alipin"
decisions.reason: Back to what Yahweh freed them from (m1).

decisions.choice: "kayo mismo"
decisions.reason: The pronoun is stressed (m2).

decisions.choice: "mga kawan"
decisions.reason: Sheep and goats (m3).

decisions.choice: "ਉਸ ਦੇ ਦਾਸ" at every level
decisions.reason: Avadim, slaves of the king; the warning needs the strong word.

records.literal_gloss: And you will cry out in the day that because of your king whom you have chosen for yourselves, and not will answer Yahweh you in the day that.

en.L: And you will cry out in that day because of your king whom you have chosen for yourselves, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will not answer you in that day."
en.B: When that day comes, you will cry out because of the king you have chosen for yourselves, but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will not answer you then."
en.R: A day will come when you cry out for help because of the king you chose. But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will not answer you."

es.L: Y {{plural_you:clamarán|clamaréis}} en aquel día a causa de {{plural_you:su rey|vuestro rey}}, que {{plural_you:ustedes se han escogido|vosotros os habéis escogido}}, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no {{plural_you:les|os}} responderá en aquel día».
es.B: Cuando llegue aquel día, {{plural_you:clamarán|clamaréis}} a causa del rey que {{plural_you:se han escogido|os habéis escogido}}, pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no {{plural_you:les|os}} responderá entonces».
es.R: Llegará un día en que {{plural_you:clamarán|clamaréis}} pidiendo ayuda por causa del rey que {{plural_you:escogieron|escogisteis}}. Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no {{plural_you:les|os}} responderá».

fr.L: Et vous crierez en ce jour-là à cause de votre roi que vous vous serez choisi, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne vous répondra pas en ce jour-là. »
fr.B: Ce jour-là, vous crierez à cause du roi que vous vous serez choisi, mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne vous répondra pas. »
fr.R: Un jour viendra où vous appellerez au secours à cause du roi que vous avez choisi. Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne vous répondra pas. »

sw.L: Nanyi mtalia siku ile kwa sababu ya mfalme wenu mliyejichagulia, wala {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hatawajibu siku ile."
sw.B: Siku ile itakapofika mtalia kwa sababu ya mfalme mliyejichagulia, lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hatawajibu wakati huo."
sw.R: Siku moja mtalia mkiomba msaada kwa sababu ya mfalme mliyemchagua. Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hatawajibu."

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy anh em sẽ kêu la vì cớ vua mà anh em đã chọn cho mình, nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ không đáp lời anh em trong ngày ấy."
vi.B: Khi ngày ấy đến, anh em sẽ kêu la vì cớ vua mà anh em đã chọn cho mình, nhưng lúc ấy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ không đáp lời anh em."
vi.R: Sẽ có ngày anh em kêu cứu vì cớ vua mà anh em đã chọn. Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ không đáp lời anh em."

ko.L: 그리고 그날에 너희는 너희가 스스로 택한 너희 왕 때문에 부르짖겠지만, 그날에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희에게 응답하지 않으실 것이다."
ko.B: 그날이 오면 너희는 스스로 택한 왕 때문에 부르짖을 것이다. 그러나 그때에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 너희에게 응답하지 않으실 것이다."
ko.R: 너희가 고른 왕 때문에 너희가 도와 달라고 부르짖을 날이 올 것이다. 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 너희에게 응답하지 않으실 것이다."

pt.L: E vocês clamarão naquele dia por causa do rei de vocês, que escolheram para si, e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não lhes responderá naquele dia."
pt.B: Quando chegar aquele dia, vocês clamarão por causa do rei que escolheram para si, mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não lhes responderá."
pt.R: Vai chegar o dia em que vocês vão gritar por socorro por causa do rei que escolheram. Mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não vai responder a vocês."

am.L: በዚያም ቀን ለራሳችሁ ከመረጣችሁት ከንጉሣችሁ የተነሣ ትጮኻላችሁ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ግን በዚያ ቀን አይመልስላችሁም።»
am.B: ያ ቀን በመጣ ጊዜ ለራሳችሁ ከመረጣችሁት ንጉሥ የተነሣ ትጮኻላችሁ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ግን ያን ጊዜ አይመልስላችሁም።»
am.R: ከመረጣችሁት ንጉሥ የተነሣ ርዳታ ለማግኘት የምትጮኹበት ቀን ይመጣል። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ግን አይመልስላችሁም።»

hi.L: और उस दिन तुम अपने उस राजा के कारण, जिसे तुमने अपने लिए चुन लिया है, दुहाई दोगे, पर उस दिन {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हें उत्तर न देंगे।"
hi.B: जब वह दिन आएगा, तब तुम उस राजा के कारण दुहाई दोगे जिसे तुमने अपने लिए चुना है, पर उस दिन {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हें उत्तर नहीं देंगे।"
hi.R: एक दिन ऐसा आएगा जब तुम उस राजा के कारण, जिसे तुमने चुना है, सहायता के लिए पुकारोगे। पर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हें उत्तर नहीं देंगे।"

ru.L: И возопите вы в тот день из-за вашего царя, которого вы избрали себе, и не ответит вам {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} в тот день.»
ru.B: Когда придёт тот день, вы будете взывать из-за царя, которого сами себе избрали, но {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} тогда не ответит вам.»
ru.R: Настанет день, когда вы будете звать на помощь из-за царя, которого вы выбрали. Но {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} не ответит вам.»

ja.L: そしてその日、あなたがたは、自分たちのために選んだ自分たちの王のゆえに叫ぶ。しかしその日、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はあなたがたに答えてはくださらない。」
ja.B: その日が来ると、あなたがたは自分で選んだ王のことで泣き叫ぶ。しかしその時、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はあなたがたに答えてはくださらない。」
ja.R: いつか、あなたたちは、自分で選んだ王のせいで苦しみ、助けを求めて叫ぶ日が来る。しかし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は答えてくださらない。」

uk.L: І закричите того дня через вашого царя, якого ви вибрали собі, але не відповість вам {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} того дня.»
uk.B: Коли настане той день, ви кричатимете через царя, якого самі собі вибрали, але {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} тоді не відповість вам.»
uk.R: Прийде день, коли ви кликатимете на поміч через царя, якого вибрали. Але {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} вам не відповість.»

id.L: Dan kalian akan berteriak pada hari itu karena raja kalian yang telah kalian pilih bagi diri kalian, tetapi {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} tidak akan menjawab kalian pada hari itu."
id.B: Pada hari itu kalian akan berteriak karena raja yang kalian pilih sendiri, tetapi {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} tidak akan menjawab kalian pada hari itu."
id.R: Suatu hari nanti kalian akan berteriak minta tolong karena raja yang kalian pilih itu. Tetapi {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} tidak akan menjawab kalian."

tl.L: At dadaing kayo sa araw na iyon dahil sa inyong hari na pinili ninyo para sa inyong sarili, at hindi kayo sasagutin {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}} sa araw na iyon."
tl.B: Pagdating ng araw na iyon, dadaing kayo dahil sa haring pinili ninyo para sa inyong sarili, ngunit hindi kayo sasagutin {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}} sa panahong iyon."
tl.R: Darating ang araw na hihingi kayo ng saklolo dahil sa haring pinili ninyo. Ngunit hindi kayo sasagutin {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}."

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਦਿਨ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆਪਣੇ ਰਾਜੇ ਦੇ ਕਾਰਨ ਦੁਹਾਈ ਦਿਓਗੇ, ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆਪਣੇ ਲਈ ਚੁਣ ਲਿਆ ਹੈ, ਅਤੇ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਉਸ ਦਿਨ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਉੱਤਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਦੇਣਗੇ।"
pa.B: ਜਦੋਂ ਉਹ ਦਿਨ ਆਵੇਗਾ, ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆਪਣੇ ਹੀ ਚੁਣੇ ਹੋਏ ਰਾਜੇ ਦੇ ਕਾਰਨ ਚੀਕ-ਪੁਕਾਰ ਕਰੋਗੇ, ਪਰ ਤਦ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਜਵਾਬ ਨਹੀਂ ਦੇਣਗੇ।"
pa.R: ਇੱਕ ਦਿਨ ਆਵੇਗਾ ਜਦੋਂ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆਪਣੇ ਚੁਣੇ ਹੋਏ ਰਾਜੇ ਦੇ ਕਾਰਨ ਮਦਦ ਲਈ ਪੁਕਾਰੋਗੇ। ਪਰ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਸੁਣਨਗੇ।"

decisions.choice: you will cry out ... Yahweh will not answer: the pattern of Judges will not hold
decisions.reason: Again and again in Judges, Israel cried out under an oppressor and Yahweh raised up someone to rescue them (Judges 3:9, 15; 6:6-7; 10:10). Israel had cried out in Egypt too (Exodus 2:23). But the oppressor Samuel foresees is a king they have chosen for themselves, and Yahweh will not rescue them from their own choice.

decisions.choice: whom you have chosen for yourselves: set against the king Yahweh chooses
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 17:15 says Israel may set over itself only a king "whom Yahweh your God chooses". Samuel stresses that this king is the people's choice, for themselves.

decisions.choice: in that day ... in that day: the verse is framed by the same phrase
decisions.reason: The repeated "in that day" ties the cry and the silence to one coming time of trouble.

decisions.choice: cry out for help
decisions.reason: As in Judges, Readable adds "for help" to show what kind of crying out this is.

decisions.choice: "dadaing kayo ... hindi kayo sasagutin ng PANGINOON"
decisions.reason: The pattern of Judges will not hold (m1).

decisions.choice: "na pinili ninyo para sa inyong sarili"
decisions.reason: Set against the king Yahweh chooses (m2).

decisions.choice: "sa araw na iyon ... sa araw na iyon"
decisions.reason: The verse is framed by the same phrase (m3).

records.literal_gloss: But refused the people to listen to [the] voice of Samuel, and they said, No, but a king shall be over us,

en.L: But the people refused to listen to the voice of Samuel, and they said, "No, but a king shall be over us,
en.B: But the people refused to listen to Samuel. "No," they said, "we will have a king over us,
en.R: But the people would not listen to Samuel. They said, "No! We want a king to rule over us.

es.L: Pero el pueblo se negó a escuchar la voz de Samuel, y dijeron: «No, sino que habrá un rey sobre nosotros,
es.B: Pero el pueblo se negó a escuchar a Samuel. «No», dijeron, «tendremos un rey sobre nosotros,
es.R: Pero el pueblo no quiso hacer caso a Samuel. Dijeron: «¡No! Queremos un rey que nos gobierne.

fr.L: Mais le peuple refusa d’écouter la voix de Samuel, et ils dirent : « Non, mais il y aura un roi sur nous,
fr.B: Mais le peuple refusa d’écouter Samuel. « Non, dirent-ils, nous aurons un roi au-dessus de nous,
fr.R: Mais le peuple n’a pas voulu écouter Samuel. Ils ont dit : « Non ! Nous voulons un roi pour régner sur nous.

sw.L: Lakini watu wakakataa kuisikiliza sauti ya Samweli, wakasema, "Hapana, bali mfalme atakuwa juu yetu,
sw.B: Lakini watu wakakataa kumsikiliza Samweli. Wakasema, "Hapana, tutakuwa na mfalme juu yetu,
sw.R: Lakini watu hawakutaka kumsikiliza Samweli. Wakasema, "Hapana! Tunataka mfalme atutawale.

vi.L: Nhưng dân chúng không chịu nghe theo tiếng Sa-mu-ên và nói: "Không, nhưng phải có một vua trên chúng tôi,
vi.B: Nhưng dân chúng không chịu nghe lời Sa-mu-ên. Họ nói: "Không, chúng tôi phải có một vua cai trị,
vi.R: Nhưng dân chúng không chịu nghe lời Sa-mu-ên. Họ nói: "Không! Chúng tôi muốn có một vua cai trị chúng tôi.

ko.L: 그러나 백성은 사무엘의 말을 듣기를 거부하고 말했다. "아닙니다. 우리 위에 왕이 있어야 합니다.
ko.B: 그러나 백성은 사무엘의 말을 듣지 않았다. 그들이 말했다. "아닙니다. 우리는 우리를 다스릴 왕을 모셔야 하겠습니다.
ko.R: 그러나 백성은 사무엘의 말을 듣지 않았다. 그들이 말했다. "아닙니다! 우리를 다스릴 왕이 있어야 합니다.

pt.L: Mas o povo se recusou a ouvir a voz de Samuel, e disseram: "Não, mas um rei haverá sobre nós,
pt.B: Mas o povo se recusou a ouvir Samuel. "Não", disseram, "teremos um rei sobre nós,
pt.R: Mas o povo não quis ouvir Samuel. Eles disseram: "Não! Queremos um rei para governar sobre nós.

am.L: ሕዝቡ ግን የሳሙኤልን ቃል ለመስማት እንቢ አሉ፤ እንዲህም አሉ፦ «አይሆንም፤ ንጉሥ በላያችን ይሆናል እንጂ፤
am.B: ሕዝቡ ግን ሳሙኤልን ለመስማት እንቢ አሉ። «አይሆንም» አሉ፤ «በላያችን ንጉሥ ይኖረናል፤
am.R: ሕዝቡ ግን ሳሙኤልን አልሰሙትም። እንዲህም አሉ፦ «አይሆንም! የሚገዛን ንጉሥ እንፈልጋለን።

hi.L: पर लोगों ने शमूएल की बात सुनने से इनकार किया, और कहा, "नहीं, हम पर एक राजा होगा,
hi.B: पर लोगों ने शमूएल की बात सुनने से इनकार कर दिया। "नहीं," उन्होंने कहा, "हम पर एक राजा होगा,
hi.R: पर लोगों ने शमूएल की बात नहीं मानी। उन्होंने कहा, "नहीं! हमें एक राजा चाहिए जो हम पर राज्य करे।

ru.L: Но народ отказался слушать голос Самуила, и сказали они: «Нет, но царь пусть будет над нами,
ru.B: Но народ не захотел слушать Самуила. «Нет», — сказали они. — «Пусть над нами будет царь,
ru.R: Но народ не стал слушать Самуила. Они сказали: «Нет! Мы хотим, чтобы над нами правил царь.

ja.L: しかし民はサムエルの声に聞き従うことを拒んで、言った。「いいえ。ただ、王がわたしたちの上にいなければなりません。
ja.B: しかし民はサムエルに聞き従おうとしなかった。「いいえ」と彼らは言った。「わたしたちの上には、どうしても王がいなければなりません。
ja.R: しかし民は、サムエルの言うことを聞こうとしませんでした。彼らは言いました。「いいえ。わたしたちは、わたしたちを治める王がほしいのです。

uk.L: Але народ не захотів слухати голосу Самуїла, і сказали вони: «Ні, але цар буде над нами,
uk.B: Але народ не захотів слухати Самуїла. «Ні», — сказали вони, — «у нас буде цар,
uk.R: Але народ не хотів слухати Самуїла. Вони сказали: «Ні! Ми хочемо, щоб над нами був цар.

id.L: Tetapi rakyat itu menolak mendengarkan suara Samuel, dan mereka berkata, "Tidak, tetapi harus ada seorang raja atas kami,
id.B: Tetapi rakyat itu tidak mau mendengarkan Samuel. "Tidak," kata mereka, "kami mau ada seorang raja atas kami,
id.R: Tetapi rakyat tidak mau mendengarkan Samuel. Mereka berkata, "Tidak! Kami mau seorang raja yang memerintah kami.

tl.L: Ngunit tumanggi ang bayan na makinig sa tinig ni Samuel, at sinabi nila, "Hindi, kundi magkakaroon ng hari sa amin,
tl.B: Ngunit tumanggi ang bayan na makinig kay Samuel. "Hindi po," sabi nila, "magkakaroon kami ng hari sa amin,

pa.L: ਪਰ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਨੇ ਸਮੂਏਲ ਦੀ ਅਵਾਜ਼ ਸੁਣਨ ਤੋਂ ਇਨਕਾਰ ਕੀਤਾ, ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਆਖਿਆ, "ਨਹੀਂ, ਸਗੋਂ ਸਾਡੇ ਉੱਤੇ ਇੱਕ ਰਾਜਾ ਹੋਵੇਗਾ,

decisions.choice: refused to listen to the voice of Samuel: would not take his warning

decisions.choice: no, but a king shall be over us: a flat refusal and an insistence

decisions.choice: "No," they said,
decisions.reason: Balanced puts "they said" inside the quotation, after the people's first word, which gives their "No" its force.

decisions.choice: "tumanggi ... na makinig sa tinig ni Samuel"

decisions.choice: we also will be like all the nations: the wish of verse 5 restated
decisions.reason: The people repeat their wish, now with "we also" stressed, in the very words Deuteronomy foresaw (Deuteronomy 17:14). It is the opposite of Israel's calling to be different from the nations (Leviticus 20:26).

decisions.choice: fight our battles: they want a warrior king
decisions.reason: Yahweh had fought for Israel (Exodus 14:14; Deuteronomy 1:30), most recently with thunder against the Philistines when Samuel prayed (7:10). The people now want a visible king to lead them in war.

decisions.choice: go out before us: lead us into battle
decisions.reason: To "go out and come in before" the people means to lead them in war (18:16; Numbers 27:17).

decisions.choice: lead us
decisions.reason: Readable says "lead" for "judge", as in verses 1 and 5.

decisions.choice: "kami rin ay magiging gaya ng lahat ng bansa"
decisions.reason: The wish of verse 5 restated (m1).

decisions.choice: "makikipaglaban sa aming mga digmaan"
decisions.reason: They want a warrior king (m2).

decisions.choice: "lalabas sa unahan namin"

tl.B: Nang marinig ni Samuel ang lahat ng sinabi ng bayan, inulit niya ito {{divine_name:sa PANGINOON|kay Yahweh}}.
tl.R: Pinakinggan ni Samuel ang lahat ng sinabi ng bayan. Pagkatapos ay sinabi niya ang lahat ng ito {{divine_name:sa PANGINOON|kay Yahweh}}.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਸਮੂਏਲ ਨੇ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਗੱਲਾਂ ਸੁਣੀਆਂ, ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਨੇ ਉਹ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਦੇ ਕੰਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਖੀਆਂ।
pa.B: ਜਦੋਂ ਸਮੂਏਲ ਨੇ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਦੀ ਸਾਰੀ ਗੱਲ ਸੁਣ ਲਈ, ਤਾਂ ਉਸ ਨੇ ਉਹ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਨੂੰ ਦੁਹਰਾ ਕੇ ਸੁਣਾਈ।
pa.R: ਸਮੂਏਲ ਨੇ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਦੀ ਹਰ ਗੱਲ ਸੁਣੀ। ਫਿਰ ਉਸ ਨੇ ਉਹ ਸਾਰੀ ਗੱਲ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਨੂੰ ਦੱਸ ਦਿੱਤੀ।

decisions.choice: spoke them in the ears of Yahweh: told Yahweh directly
decisions.reason: To speak "in the ears of" someone is to say it to them in person. Samuel brings the people's words to Yahweh, as he brought Yahweh's words to the people (verse 10).

decisions.choice: all the words of the people: matching all the words of Yahweh
decisions.reason: Verse 10 said Samuel told the people "all the words of Yahweh"; now he tells Yahweh "all the words of the people". Samuel stands between them as go-between.

decisions.choice: repeated it to (Balanced); told ... all of it (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the Hebrew picture "in the ears of".

decisions.choice: "sinabi niya ang mga ito sa mga tainga ng PANGINOON"
decisions.reason: Told Yahweh directly (m1).

decisions.choice: "ang lahat ng salita ng bayan"
decisions.reason: Matching all the words of Yahweh in verse 10 (m2).

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֤ה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל֙ שְׁמַ֣ע בְּקוֹלָ֔ם וְהִמְלַכְתָּ֥ לָהֶ֖ם מֶ֑לֶךְ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶל־אַנְשֵׁ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְכ֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ לְעִירֽוֹ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh to Samuel, Listen to their voice and make reign for them a king. And said Samuel to [the] men of Israel, Go each man to his city.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to Samuel, "Listen to their voice, and make a king reign over them." And Samuel said to the men of Israel, "Go, each man to his city."
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Samuel, "Do as they ask, and give them a king." Then Samuel said to the men of Israel, "Go back, each of you, to your own town."
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} told Samuel, "Do what they ask. Give them a king." Then Samuel said to the leaders of Israel, "All of you, go back home to your towns."

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo a Samuel: «Escucha su voz, y pon un rey que reine sobre ellos». Y Samuel dijo a los hombres de Israel: «{{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} cada uno a su ciudad».
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Samuel: «Haz lo que te piden y dales un rey». Entonces Samuel dijo a los hombres de Israel: «{{plural_you:Vuelvan|Volved}} cada uno a su ciudad».
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Samuel: «Haz lo que te piden. Dales un rey». Entonces Samuel les dijo a los líderes de Israel: «{{plural_you:Vuelvan|Volved}} todos a {{plural_you:sus casas|vuestras casas}}, a {{plural_you:sus ciudades|vuestras ciudades}}».

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Samuel : « Écoute leur voix et fais régner sur eux un roi. » Et Samuel dit aux hommes d’Israël : « Allez-vous-en chacun dans sa ville. »
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Samuel : « Accède à leur demande et donne-leur un roi. » Puis Samuel dit aux hommes d’Israël : « Retournez chacun dans votre ville. »
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit à Samuel : « Fais ce qu’ils demandent. Donne-leur un roi. » Ensuite, Samuel a dit aux responsables d’Israël : « Rentrez tous chez vous, dans vos villes. »

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Samweli, "Isikilize sauti yao, ukawatawazie mfalme." Na Samweli akawaambia watu wa Israeli, "Nendeni, kila mtu mjini kwake."
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Samweli, "Fanya wanavyoomba, uwape mfalme." Kisha Samweli akawaambia watu wa Israeli, "Rudini, kila mmoja wenu mjini kwake."
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Samweli, "Fanya wanavyoomba. Wape mfalme." Kisha Samweli akawaambia viongozi wa Israeli, "Nyote rudini nyumbani mijini kwenu."

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Sa-mu-ên: "Hãy nghe theo tiếng họ và lập cho họ một vua." Sa-mu-ên nói với người Y-sơ-ra-ên: "Ai nấy hãy về thành mình."
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Sa-mu-ên: "Hãy làm theo điều họ xin và lập cho họ một vua." Rồi Sa-mu-ên nói với người Y-sơ-ra-ên: "Mỗi người hãy trở về thành mình."
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Sa-mu-ên: "Hãy làm theo điều họ xin. Hãy lập cho họ một vua." Rồi Sa-mu-ên nói với các nhà lãnh đạo Y-sơ-ra-ên: "Tất cả hãy trở về thành mình."

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 사무엘에게 말씀하셨다. "그들의 말을 들어주어 그들에게 왕을 세워 주어라." 그러자 사무엘이 이스라엘 사람들에게 말했다. "각자 자기 성읍으로 가거라."
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 사무엘에게 말씀하셨다. "그들의 말대로 해 주어라. 그들에게 왕을 세워 주어라." 그러자 사무엘이 이스라엘 사람들에게 말했다. "모두 각자 자기 성읍으로 돌아가거라."
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 사무엘에게 말씀하셨다. "그들이 원하는 대로 해 주어라. 그들에게 왕을 세워 주어라." 그러자 사무엘이 이스라엘의 지도자들에게 말했다. "모두 자기 성읍으로 돌아가거라."

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse a Samuel: "Ouve a voz deles, e faze reinar sobre eles um rei." E Samuel disse aos homens de Israel: "Vão, cada um para a sua cidade."
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} disse a Samuel: "Atende o pedido deles e dá-lhes um rei." Então Samuel disse aos homens de Israel: "Voltem, cada um para a sua cidade."
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} disse a Samuel: "Faze o que eles pedem. Dá a eles um rei." Então Samuel disse aos líderes de Israel: "Voltem todos para as suas cidades."

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም ሳሙኤልን፦ «ቃላቸውን ስማ፤ ንጉሥም አንግሥላቸው» አለው። ሳሙኤልም የእስራኤልን ሰዎች፦ «እያንዳንዳችሁ ወደ ከተማችሁ ሂዱ» አላቸው።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሳሙኤልን፦ «የጠየቁህን አድርግ፤ ንጉሥም ስጣቸው» አለው። ከዚያም ሳሙኤል የእስራኤልን ሰዎች፦ «እያንዳንዳችሁ ወደየከተማችሁ ተመለሱ» አላቸው።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሳሙኤልን፦ «የጠየቁህን አድርግ። ንጉሥ ስጣቸው» አለው። ከዚያም ሳሙኤል የእስራኤልን መሪዎች፦ «ሁላችሁም ወደየከተማችሁ ወደ ቤታችሁ ተመለሱ» አላቸው።

hi.L: और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने शमूएल से कहा, "उनकी बात सुनो, और उन पर एक राजा ठहराओ।" और शमूएल ने इस्राएल के पुरुषों से कहा, "हर एक अपने नगर को जाओ।"
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने शमूएल से कहा, "वे जैसा कहते हैं, वैसा करो, और उन्हें एक राजा दो।" तब शमूएल ने इस्राएल के पुरुषों से कहा, "तुम सब अपने-अपने नगर को लौट जाओ।"
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने शमूएल से कहा, "वे जो माँगते हैं, वही करो। उन्हें एक राजा दो।" तब शमूएल ने इस्राएल के अगुवों से कहा, "तुम सब अपने-अपने नगर को घर लौट जाओ।"

ru.L: И сказал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Самуилу: «Слушай их голос и поставь им царя.» И сказал Самуил мужам Израиля: «Идите каждый в свой город.»
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал Самуилу: «Сделай, как они просят, и дай им царя.» Тогда Самуил сказал людям Израиля: «Возвращайтесь каждый в свой город.»
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал Самуилу: «Сделай то, о чём они просят. Дай им царя.» Тогда Самуил сказал вождям Израиля: «Расходитесь все по домам, по своим городам.»

ja.L: そして{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はサムエルに言われた。「彼らの声に聞き従い、彼らのために王を立てて治めさせなさい。」そしてサムエルはイスラエルの人々に言った。「それぞれ自分の町へ行きなさい。」
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はサムエルに言われた。「彼らの願いを聞き入れ、彼らに王を与えなさい。」そこでサムエルはイスラエルの人々に言った。「それぞれ自分の町に帰りなさい。」
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はサムエルに言われました。「彼らの願うとおりにしなさい。彼らに王を与えなさい。」そこでサムエルは、イスラエルの指導者たちに言いました。「みな、自分の町の家に帰りなさい。」

uk.L: І сказав {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Самуїлові: «Послухай їхнього голосу і постав їм царя.» І сказав Самуїл мужам Ізраїлю: «Ідіть кожен до свого міста.»
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав Самуїлові: «Зроби, як вони просять, і дай їм царя.» Тоді Самуїл сказав мужам Ізраїлю: «Ідіть, кожен до свого міста.»
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав Самуїлові: «Зроби, як вони просять. Дай їм царя.» Тоді Самуїл сказав провідникам Ізраїлю: «Ідіть усі додому, до своїх міст.»

id.L: Dan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} berfirman kepada Samuel, "Dengarkanlah suara mereka, dan angkatlah seorang raja atas mereka." Lalu Samuel berkata kepada orang-orang Israel, "Pulanglah, masing-masing ke kotanya."
id.B: {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} berfirman kepada Samuel, "Dengarkanlah permintaan mereka dan angkatlah seorang raja bagi mereka." Lalu Samuel berkata kepada orang-orang Israel, "Pulanglah, masing-masing ke kotanya."
id.R: {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} berfirman kepada Samuel, "Lakukanlah apa yang mereka minta. Berikanlah seorang raja kepada mereka." Kemudian Samuel berkata kepada para pemimpin Israel, "Pulanglah kalian semua ke kota masing-masing."

tl.L: At sinabi {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}} kay Samuel, "Pakinggan mo ang kanilang tinig, at magpaghari ka ng isang hari sa kanila." At sinabi ni Samuel sa mga lalaki ng Israel, "Umuwi kayo, bawat lalaki sa kaniyang lungsod."
tl.B: Sinabi {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}} kay Samuel, "Gawin mo ang hinihiling nila, at bigyan mo sila ng isang hari." Pagkatapos ay sinabi ni Samuel sa mga lalaki ng Israel, "Bumalik kayo, bawat isa sa inyo, sa inyong sariling bayan."
tl.R: Sinabi {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}} kay Samuel, "Gawin mo ang hinihiling nila. Bigyan mo sila ng isang hari." Pagkatapos ay sinabi ni Samuel sa mga pinuno ng Israel, "Umuwi na kayong lahat sa inyong mga bayan."

pa.L: ਅਤੇ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਨੇ ਸਮੂਏਲ ਨੂੰ ਆਖਿਆ, "ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਅਵਾਜ਼ ਸੁਣ, ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਉੱਤੇ ਇੱਕ ਰਾਜਾ ਬਿਠਾ।" ਅਤੇ ਸਮੂਏਲ ਨੇ ਇਸਰਾਏਲ ਦੇ ਮਨੁੱਖਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਆਖਿਆ, "ਹਰੇਕ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਆਪਣੇ ਸ਼ਹਿਰ ਨੂੰ ਜਾਵੇ।"
pa.B: {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਨੇ ਸਮੂਏਲ ਨੂੰ ਕਿਹਾ, "ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਕਹੇ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਕਰ, ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਇੱਕ ਰਾਜਾ ਦੇ।" ਤਦ ਸਮੂਏਲ ਨੇ ਇਸਰਾਏਲ ਦੇ ਆਦਮੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਕਿਹਾ, "ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਹਰੇਕ ਆਪਣੇ ਨਗਰ ਨੂੰ ਮੁੜ ਜਾਵੇ।"
pa.R: {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਨੇ ਸਮੂਏਲ ਨੂੰ ਦੱਸਿਆ, "ਉਹ ਜੋ ਮੰਗਦੇ ਹਨ ਉਹੀ ਕਰ। ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਇੱਕ ਰਾਜਾ ਦੇ ਦੇ।" ਫਿਰ ਸਮੂਏਲ ਨੇ ਇਸਰਾਏਲ ਦੇ ਆਗੂਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਕਿਹਾ, "ਤੁਸੀਂ ਸਾਰੇ ਆਪਣੇ-ਆਪਣੇ ਨਗਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਘਰ ਮੁੜ ਜਾਓ।"

decisions.choice: listen to their voice and make a king for them: Yahweh's third command
decisions.reason: For the third time Yahweh tells Samuel to grant the people's request (verses 7, 9). The verb "make reign" comes from the same root as "king".

decisions.choice: the men of Israel ... go each to his city: the elders are sent home
decisions.reason: "The men of Israel" are the elders who came to Ramah (verse 4). Samuel sends them home without naming a king. The story of how Yahweh chooses Saul follows (9:1-10:24).

decisions.choice: city: a town of any size
decisions.reason: The word names any walled settlement, large or small.

decisions.choice: Do as they ask, and give them a king
decisions.reason: As in verses 7 and 9, "listen to their voice" means to grant what they ask. Balanced and Readable say "give them a king" for "make a king reign over them".

decisions.choice: the leaders of Israel
decisions.reason: Readable says "leaders" because the men meant are the elders of verse 4 (see m2).

decisions.choice: "Pakinggan mo ang kanilang tinig, at magpaghari ka ng isang hari sa kanila"
decisions.reason: Yahweh's third command (m1).

decisions.choice: "Umuwi kayo, bawat lalaki sa kaniyang lungsod"
decisions.reason: The elders are sent home (m2).

decisions.choice: "lungsod"
decisions.reason: A town of any size (m3).
